theorems.natural_language_statement:
Fix a prime $p$ and a modulus $M$ with $p \mid M$ and $p^2 \nmid M$, a subgroup $H \le (\mathbb{Z}/M)^\times$ containing every unit that reduces to $1$ in $(\mathbb{Z}/(M/p))^\times$, and assume $j(q) \in$ `qExpFunctionFieldC ℚ ⊤`. Let $\mathfrak{X}$ be an `XHDRModelAtP p M H hpM hj` datum, so in particular a curve model `𝔛.Meta` over $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$ with function field $F_M =$ `xHFunctionFieldBar M H`, together with its fibre data at $p$. Let $A$ be a valuation subring of $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$ with $p$ a nonunit, with algebraically closed residue field $\kappa$ of characteristic $p$, and $\rho : R_p \to A$ a lift of `algebraMap (R p) (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)`. Let $pb$ be a unit of $\mathbb{Z}/(M/p)$ represented by $p$, and let $\delta$ act on places of $\bar F =$ `Fbar p M H hpM κ` through the semilinear automorphism attached to the diamond automorphism `diamondActionModL κ (M/p) (infSubgroup p M H hpM)` of the $\Gamma_0(M/p)$-lift of $pb$. Let $\theta$ be an automorphism of $F_M$ over $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$ inducing on places of `𝔛.Meta` the action of the isomorphism `𝔛.w` (hypothesis `hwgen`), let $\alpha : F_{M/p} \to F_M$ be an $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$-algebra map which is the identity on Laurent series and is integral, with $\theta \circ \alpha$ also integral. Let `Psp` be a place-specialization datum for $(p,M,H,A)$ and `Rpd` a prolongation datum for it and $\theta$, consisting of two regular prolongations $R_1,R_2$ of $A$ to $F_M$ with values in $\bar F$; assume `hres₂α`, that on elements $\alpha v$ lying in both $R_1$ and $R_2$ the second residue is the $p$-power $q$-expansion Frobenius of the first, and `hcomp`, the compatibility of the two components of the fibre of $\mathfrak{X}$ over $\kappa$ with the two readings `Psp.reduceFst α` and `Psp.reduceSnd (θ ∘ α) δ` of places. Let $v$ be a place of $\bar F$ over $\kappa$ which is the first reading of some $\infty$-side place, let $ft \in F_M$ have $q$-expansion $j(q^p)\cdot j(q)^{-p}$, and let $W$ be a place of $F_M$ over $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$ which is a zero-side place (cuspidal in the sense of `IsCuspidal'`, with $j(q)/j(q^p)^p$ taking at $W$ a value in $A$ with residue $1$) whose first reading is $v$. Then there is an $a \in A$ such that $ft - a$ lies in the integers of $R_1$, the residue $R_1(ft-a) \in \bar F$ does not have value $0$ at $v$, and $\mathrm{ord}_W(ft - a) > 0$.

This provides the separating function at the zero-side places lying over the first reading of an $\infty$-side cusp: the shifted Hasse-type parameter $t_\infty - a$ is a unit at $v$ after reduction while vanishing to positive order at $W$. It is used to produce a cusp chart at an $\infty$-side place, in [`ModularCurve.XHDRModelAtP.exists_isCuspChartFstAt_of_isInftySide_prolongationDatum`](thm.html#ModularCurve.XHDRModelAtP.exists_isCuspChartFstAt_of_isInftySide_prolongationDatum), within the analysis of the two cusps above $\infty$ on the reduction at $p$ of $X_H$.

Fix a prime $p$ and $M$ with $p \mid M$ but $p^2 \nmid M$, a subgroup $H \le (\mathbb{Z}/M)^{\times}$ containing every unit whose image under reduction to $(\mathbb{Z}/(M/p))^{\times}$ is trivial, and assume $j$, as a Laurent $q$-series over $\mathbb{Q}$, lies in the full-level $q$-expansion field; let $\mathfrak{X}$ be an `XHDRModelAtP` datum for these data. Let $A$ be a valuation subring of $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$ with $p$ a non-unit of $A$, residue field $\kappa$ algebraically closed of characteristic $p$, and $\rho : R_p \to A$ a ring homomorphism inducing the structure map to $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$. The remaining data are: a unit $pb$ of $\mathbb{Z}/(M/p)$ reducing to $p$; the operator $\delta$ on places of $\bar F =$ `JHNeronObjectAtP.Fbar p M H hpM κ` given by the semilinear action of the mod-$\ell$ diamond automorphism attached to $pb$; an $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$-automorphism $\theta$ of the level-$M$ function field implementing the correspondence $\mathfrak{X}.w$ on points; an integral $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$-algebra map $\alpha$ from the level-$(M/p)$ function field to the level-$M$ one which is the identity on $q$-expansions, with $\theta \circ \alpha$ also integral; a place specialisation $Psp$ and a prolongation datum $Rpd$ for $Psp$ and $\theta$, with the compatibility that $R_2$-residues of $\alpha v$ are the $q$-expansion Frobenius of their $R_1$-residues, and the compatibility `hcomp` identifying the places of the fibre model attached to points of the two components with `reduceFst` along $\alpha$ and `reduceSnd` along $\theta \circ \alpha$ twisted by $\delta$; an element $x'$ of the level-$(M/p)$ field whose $q$-expansion is $j$; and the hypothesis `hB` that $\alpha$ carries the subring $B$ generated by the constants from $A$ together with all elements whose $q$-expansions come from the pole chart `chartAlgInf p (ΓN p M H hpM) hj` into the integers of $R_1$. Finally let $v \ne v'$ be places of $\bar F$ over $\kappa$ that are not affine, i.e. for neither of them is there an element of $\bar F$ with $q$-expansion $j$ taking a finite value there. Then there exists $b \in B$ such that the $R_1$-residue of $\alpha b$ lies in the valuation ring of $v'$ with residue $0$, while it does not have value $0$ at $v$.

This is the separation of distinct cusps of the mod-$p$ fibre by functions coming from the pole chart at level $M/p$, with coefficients allowed from the valuation ring $A$: the two generating families of the subring $B$ are both used, the separator being an $A$-coefficient combination of reduced chart functions. It feeds the construction of cusp-chart elements with prescribed specialisation behaviour in [`ModularCurve.XHDRModelAtP.exists_mul_eq_of_mem_integers_of_forall_sp_eq_cuspChartSetInf_prolongationDatum`](thm.html#ModularCurve.XHDRModelAtP.exists_mul_eq_of_mem_integers_of_forall_sp_eq_cuspChartSetInf_prolongationDatum).

Throughout, $\kappa$ denotes `ResidueField A`, $\mathcal C$ the field `modularFunctionFieldC κ M'` $=\kappa(j,j_{M'})$ generated over $\kappa$ by the Laurent series `jqModC κ` and `jqNModC κ M'`, $\mathcal M$ the field `modularFunctionFieldBar M'` obtained from `modularFunctionFieldFull M'` (the subfield of $\mathbb Q((q))$ generated by the series `qExpand ℚ d jq` for $d\mid M'$) by adjoining its coefficientwise image to $\overline{\mathbb Q}((q))$, and $\mathcal F$ the field `fieldBar q M'` $=$ `xHFunctionFieldBar (q^2*M') (levelH q M')`, the analogous base change to $\overline{\mathbb Q}$ of the function field of $X_H$ of level $q^2M'$ with $H=$`levelH q M'` the kernel of $(\mathbb Z/q^2M')^\times\to(\mathbb Z/q)^\times$, i.e. the units congruent to $1$ modulo $q$.

**Data and frame.** A prime $q$ with $5\le q$ (`hq`); a nonzero $M'$ with $q\nmid M'$ (`hqM'`); a valuation subring $A\subseteq\overline{\mathbb Q}$ with `hA : A.LiesOverPrime q`, that is, $q$ is a non-unit of $A$. A finite set $W$ of places of $\mathcal C$ over $\kappa$ whose members are exactly the supersingular places (`hW`): those $w$ with `w.IsRational`, `IsAffineGeomPlace κ M' w`, and $w$-value `w.evalAt (jGeomGen κ M')` lying in `ssJSet q κ`. The inclusion `hle :` $\mathcal M\le\mathcal F$. A constant reduction $R_0$ of $A$ from $\mathcal M$ to $\mathcal C$, i.e. a valuation subring `R₀.integers` of $\mathcal M$ meeting the constants exactly in $A$, a surjective residue homomorphism onto $\mathcal C$ with kernel the maximal ideal and the usual compatibility on constants and normalisation, together with a map on places compatible with degrees and with principal divisors. The hypothesis `hR₀`: for every Laurent series $y$ over $A$ whose coefficientwise image lies in $\mathcal M$, that element lies in `R₀.integers` and its $R_0$-residue is, as a Laurent series over $\kappa$, the coefficientwise reduction of $y$. A chosen supersingular place $s\in W$.

A constant-field frame: an intermediate field $k_0$ of $\overline{\mathbb Q}/\mathbb Q$ and $\pi_0\in k_0$ with $\pi_0\in A$ (`hπ`), such that $A\cap k_0$ (the comap of $A$ along $k_0\hookrightarrow\overline{\mathbb Q}$) is a discrete valuation ring (`hdvr`) with maximal ideal generated by $\pi_0$ (`hunif`), is henselian (`hhens`), has algebraically closed residue field (`hres`), and such that every element of $A$ is congruent modulo the maximal ideal of $A$ to an element of $k_0\cap A$ (`hκ`).

Auxiliary arithmetic data: a prime $\ell$ with $3\le\ell$, $\ell\ne q$, $\ell\nmid M'$; an element $\zeta_0\in k_0$ which is a primitive $q\ell$-th root of unity; an element $\varpi_t\in k_0\cap A$ with $\varpi_t^{\,q^2-1}=q\cdot u$ for some unit $u$ of $A$ (`hϖt`); an element $\pi_t\in A$ with $\pi_t^{\,q^2-1}=q$.

Layer data: a type of layer indices, a family $K$ of intermediate fields of $\overline{\mathbb Q}/k_0$, each finite over $k_0$ (`hKfin`), valuation subrings $A_n$ of $K_n$ induced by $A$ (`hAn`), a least index $n_0$ with $K_{n_0}\le K_n$ for all $n$ (`hn₀`), and cofinality `hKcof`: every finite subset of $\overline{\mathbb Q}$ is contained in the image of some $K_n$. The tameness hypothesis `htame`: every $\tau$ in `A.inertiaSubgroupIn ℚ` with `A.tameCharacter πt τ = 1` fixes $K_{n_0}$ pointwise.

Bottom-layer data: an intermediate field $K_b$ of $\overline{\mathbb Q}/k_0$ with $K_b=\bot$ (`hKb`), a valuation subring $A_b$ of $K_b$ induced by $A$ (`hAb`), and $\varpi_b\in A_b$, nonzero, generating the maximal ideal of $A_b$.

**Quantification.** With $\mathcal F$ regarded as a $k_0$-algebra through $k_0\hookrightarrow\overline{\mathbb Q}\to\mathcal F$, the assertion is made for every intermediate field $F_0$ of $\mathcal F/k_0$ satisfying four conditions: (i) $f\in F_0$ if and only if every Laurent coefficient of $f$ lies in $k_0$; (ii) the constants $\overline{\mathbb Q}$ and $F_0$ together generate $\mathcal F$, i.e. `adjoin k₀ (range (algebraMap Qbar 𝓕)) ⊔ F₀ = ⊤`; (iii) $F_0$ is stable under `levelAutBar q M' ζ γ` for every $\zeta\in$ `Idx q` (a primitive $q$-th root of unity in $\overline{\mathbb Q}$) and every $\gamma\in\Gamma_0(M')$; (iv) linear disjointness: for every intermediate field $K'$ of $\overline{\mathbb Q}/k_0$ finite over $k_0$, every $K'$-linearly independent family $c:\mathrm{Fin}\,m\to\overline{\mathbb Q}$ and every family $a$ of elements of `adjoin k₀ (image of K') ⊔ F₀` with $\sum_i c_i a_i=0$ has all $a_i=0$.

Further, for every valuation subring $W_0$ of $F_0$, every subring $B$ of $\mathcal F$ with an $A_b$-algebra structure `alg`, and: `hjR`, the base change of `jq` lies in `R₀.integers`; `hjs`, its $R_0$-residue lies in the valuation subring of $s$; `hJK`, `jqNModC Qbar q` $\in\mathcal F$; an element $a_0\in k_0\cap A$ whose residue satisfies `hpin`: $(\mathrm{res}_A a_0)^q=s.\mathrm{evalAt}(R_0.\mathrm{residue}\,j)$ (a Hasse-style $q$-th root of the $j$-value at $s$); and a finite set `nodes` of subrings of $F_0$.

**Premise (the opened level-field model datum).** The assertion is made under the conjunction of the following groups, whose content is summarised here. (1) $W_0$-clauses: $x\in A\iff$ the image of $x$ lies in $W_0$, for $x\in k_0$; $W_0$ is a discrete valuation ring; the image of $\pi_0$ generates its maximal ideal. (2) The $s$-reading clause for $W_0$: for every $g$ in `modularFunctionFieldFull M'` whose base change lies in `R₀.integers`, which has no pole at any place of $\mathcal M$ where `jq` has none, and whose $R_0$-residue lies in the valuation subring of $s$, the image of $g$ in $\mathcal F$ lies in $F_0$ and in $W_0$, and for every $c\in k_0\cap A$ whose residue equals $s.\mathrm{evalAt}(R_0.\mathrm{residue}\,g)$ the difference of the two lies in the maximal ideal of $W_0$. (3) Level-equivariance of $W_0$ under `levelAutBar q M' ζ γ`, $\gamma\in\Gamma_0(M')$. (4) Chart clauses for $B$: the $A_b$-algebra structure is the inclusion of constants; $B$ is contained in `adjoin k₀ (image of K_b) ⊔ F₀` and that field is the fraction field of $B$; $B$ is formally smooth and of finite presentation over $A_b$ and $B/(\varpi_b)$ has Krull dimension at most $1$; $B\subseteq W_0$ inside $F_0$; $\varpi_b$ is prime in $B$; $W_0$ is the localisation of $B$ away from $\varpi_b$; `jq` lies in $B$; $B$ is stable under the level automorphisms; two separation clauses producing elements of $B$ excluded from every valuation subring of $F_0$ which is $A$-compatible on $k_0$ and either residually transcendental at `jq` with $\pi_0$ in its maximal ideal, or satisfies the reading clause at another supersingular place $s'\ne s$; and a Drinfeld-curve comparison: for every $\mathbb F_{q^2}$-algebra structure on $\kappa$, every witness that [`DrinfeldCurve.CoordRing q κ`](def/DrinfeldCurve_CoordRing.html#L21) is a domain and every $\zeta\in$ `Idx q`, there are a subgroup $C_s$ of the $(q+1)$-st roots of unity of $\mathbb F_{q^2}$ with $\#C_s=2\,$`placeWidthChar q M' s` and a ring homomorphism $\rho$ from $B$ to [`DrinfeldCurve.quotField q κ Cs`](def/ModularCurve_FullLevelSemistableCoveringW2.html#L32) with kernel $(\varpi_b)$, acting on constants through $\mathrm{res}_A$, with the target as fraction field of the image, with image exactly the elements whose image in the Drinfeld function field comes from the coordinate ring, and intertwining `levelAutBar q M' ζ γ⁻¹` with [`DrinfeldCurve.hFunctionFieldAction q κ (redQ q γ, 1)`](def/DrinfeldCurve_FunctionField.html#L16) for $\gamma\in\Gamma_0(M')$ with $(\mathrm{redQ}\,\gamma,1)\in$ `hSubgroup q`. Here `placeWidthChar q M' s` is `jWidthChar q` of the value of the geometric $j$-coordinate at $s$ divided by the ramification index `placeRamificationJ M' s`. (5) Node clauses: `nodes.card = q + 1`; a common chart $B_c$, generated by the constants from $k_0\cap A$ together with a finite set, contained in every node and having every node as a localisation of it; equivariance of `nodes` under the level automorphisms and transitivity of that action; pairwise separation of distinct nodes by an element which is a non-unit in one and a unit in the other; a covering clause: every valuation subring of $F_0$ which is $A$-compatible on $k_0$ and satisfies the reading clause at $s$ either contains $B$ or dominates a node; and, for each node $O$, a per-node block: $O\subseteq W_0$, $O$ local and noetherian, $A$-compatible on $k_0$, every element of $O$ congruent to a constant from $k_0\cap A$ modulo non-units, and the existence of an exponent $E_0\ge1$ with $\pi_0^{E_0}=\varpi_t^{\,2\,\mathrm{placeWidthChar}\,q\,M'\,s}\cdot v$ for a unit $v$ of $k_0\cap A$, of elements $c_x,c_y\in O$ and a unit $u$ with $c_xc_y=\pi_0^{E_0}u$, of an isomorphism of the adic completion of $O$ with the crossing model `UVCrossingModel` of the completion of $A\cap k_0$ at $\pi_0^{E_0}$ carrying constants to constants and $c_x,c_y$ to unit multiples of the two crossing coordinates $U,V$, with $c_y$ in the maximal ideal of $W_0$ and $c_x$ a unit there, of an Igusa germ clause (the element `jqNModC Qbar q` $-a_0$ lies in $O$ and is a unit times $V^e$ with $e\ge1$), of an Igusa branch $W_x$ (a discrete valuation subring of $F_0$ containing $O$, $A$-compatible, uniformised by $\pi_0$, residually transcendental at some element, with $c_x$ in its maximal ideal and $c_y$ a unit, satisfying the reading clauses relating $R_0$-residues, $s$ and $O$, and excluding every other node), and of a node chart $B_x$ (contained in $B\cap O$, with elements having no pole where `jq` has none, having $O$ as a localisation and $F_0$ as fraction field, generated by the constants from $k_0\cap A$ together with a finite set, and containing a separator excluded from every valuation subring that is $A$-compatible, has $\pi_0$ in its maximal ideal, is residually transcendental at `jq`, and fails to contain $O$).

**Conclusion.** Under that premise, for every field $F_{ss}$ over $\kappa$ and every regular prolongation $R$ of $A$ from $\mathcal F$ to $F_{ss}$ (a valuation subring `R.integers` meeting the constants in $A$, with surjective residue map onto $F_{ss}$ with kernel the maximal ideal, compatible on constants and normalised) such that $R.\mathrm{integers}\cap F_0=W_0$; for every node $O\in$ `nodes`; for every $E_0\ge1$ admitting a unit $v$ of $k_0\cap A$ with $\pi_0^{E_0}=\varpi_t^{\,2\,\mathrm{placeWidthChar}\,q\,M'\,s}\,v$; and for every layer completion datum, namely subrings $C'_l\subseteq A$ of $\overline{\mathbb Q}$ which are discrete valuation domains with uniformisers $\varpi'_l$, complete discrete valuation rings $W_l$ with elements $\pi_l$, natural numbers $e_l$ and ring homomorphisms $j_l:C'_l\to W_l$, subject to: $C'_l=A\cap K_l$; $\mathrm{res}_A$ vanishes on $d\in C'_l$ exactly when $\varpi'_l\mid d$; $C'_{n_0}\le C'_l$; $\pi_l$ irreducible; $\pi_0=v\,(\varpi'_l)^{e_l}$ for a unit $v$ of $C'_l$; $j_l(\varpi'_l)=\pi_l$; $j_l$ reflects the $\pi_l$-adic filtration; and $j_l$ has dense image modulo every power of $\pi_l$ — there exist a place $nd$ of $F_{ss}$ over $\kappa$, a field $F_I$ over $\kappa$, a regular prolongation $R_x$ of $A$ from $\mathcal F$ to $F_I$, a place $b_x$ of $F_I$ over $\kappa$, a valuation subring $W_x$ of $F_0$, a set $S$ of places of $\mathcal F$ over $\overline{\mathbb Q}$, a subring $\mathcal N$ of $\mathcal F$, a family $\mathcal N_0(l)$ of subrings of $\mathcal F$ which are local and noetherian, and elements $c_x,c_y,c_u$ of $\mathcal F$, such that all of the following hold.

$nd$ is rational, i.e. $\kappa\to nd$'s residue field is surjective. $R_x.\mathrm{integers}\cap F_0=W_x$. $O\subseteq W_x$. The image of $\pi_0$, if it lies in $W_x$, lies in the maximal ideal of $W_x$. There is an element $c_{yO}\in O$ whose image in $\mathcal F$ is $c_y$, which is a unit of $W_x$ (not in its maximal ideal), and which makes $W_x$ minimal: every valuation subring $V$ of $F_0$ containing $O$, with the image of $\pi_0$ in its maximal ideal and $c_{yO}$ a unit of $V$, contains $W_x$. For every node $O'\ne O$ there is $g$ lying in both $O$ and $O'$ of the form $g=c\,u$ with $c\in O$ having image $c_x$ in $\mathcal F$ and $u$ a unit of $O$, such that $g$ is a unit of $O'$.

Next: $O$ belongs to `nodes`; $O\subseteq\mathcal N_0(n_0)$ and non-units of $O$ remain non-units there; $S$ consists exactly of the places $P$ of $\mathcal F$ dominating $O$, that is, $O\subseteq P$'s valuation subring and for every non-unit $f$ of $O$ the value $P.\mathrm{evalAt}\,f$ lies in $A$ and in its maximal ideal; every $f\in O$ lying in `R.integers` has $R$-residue in the valuation subring of $nd$, and non-units of $O$ have $R$-residue in the maximal ideal of that valuation subring; and $nd$ is the unique place of $F_{ss}$ over $\kappa$ with these last two properties.

Further: $b_x$, $nd$ and every $P\in S$ are rational. $\mathcal N$ consists exactly of the elements of $\mathcal F$ lying in `Rx.integers`, in `R.integers` and in the valuation subring of every $P\in S$; and $P.\mathrm{evalAt}\,f\in A$ for all $f\in\mathcal N$ and $P\in S$. The crossing relation $c_xc_y=(\varpi'_{n_0})^{e_{n_0}E_0}\,c_u$ holds in $\mathcal F$ (constants being mapped from $\overline{\mathbb Q}$). The four residue clauses: if $c_x\in$ `Rx.integers` then its $R_x$-residue is $0$; if $c_x\in$ `R.integers` then $nd.\mathrm{ord}$ of its $R$-residue is $1$; if $c_y\in$ `R.integers` then its $R$-residue is $0$; if $c_y\in$ `Rx.integers` then $b_x.\mathrm{ord}$ of its $R_x$-residue is $1$.

Galois invariance: for every $\tau$ in `A.inertiaSubgroupIn ℚ` with `A.tameCharacter πt τ = 1`, writing $g$ for the semilinear automorphism [`ModularCurve.arithmeticGalois (xHFunctionField (q^2*M') (levelH q M')) τ`](def/ModularCurve_ArithmeticGalois.html#L54) of $\mathcal F$ given by applying $\tau$ to Laurent coefficients, one has $P\in S\iff g\cdot P\in S$ for all places $P$, and $g\cdot c_x=c_x$, $g\cdot c_y=c_y$.

Generation: every $f\in\mathcal F$ is a ratio $a/b$ with $a,b\in\mathcal N_0(l)$ for some layer $l$ and $b\ne0$; and every $f\in\mathcal F$ satisfies $f\,b=\sum_i c_i a_i$ for some $b\ne0$ and $a_i$ in $\mathcal N_0(n_0)$ and scalars $c_i\in\overline{\mathbb Q}$.

Layerwise clauses: for every $l$, $\mathcal N_0(n_0)\le\mathcal N_0(l)\le\mathcal N$; $S$ is characterised by $\mathcal N_0(l)$ in the same way as above ($P\in S$ iff $\mathcal N_0(l)$ is contained in $P$'s valuation subring and every non-unit of $\mathcal N_0(l)$ has $P$-value in the maximal ideal of $A$); the constants $C'_l$ map into $\mathcal N_0(l)$ and every element of $\mathcal N_0(l)$ is congruent to such a constant modulo non-units; $C'_l$-linearly independent scalar families impose linear independence, i.e. $\sum_i c_i a_i=0$ with $c$ independent over $C'_l$ forces all $a_i=0$ for $a_i\in\mathcal N_0(l)$; there is a subring $B_x$ of $\mathcal F$ contained in $\mathcal N_0(l)$, containing $c_x,c_y,c_u$, having $\mathcal N_0(l)$ as its localisation at the non-units, and generated by the constants from $C'_l$ together with a finite set; $c_x,c_y\in\mathcal N_0(l)$ and $c_u$ is a unit of $\mathcal N_0(l)$; and there are a ring homomorphism $\sigma:W_l\to$ `AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal 𝒩₀L l) (𝒩₀L l)` and an isomorphism $\iota_c$ of that completion with the crossing model `UVCrossingModel (Wc l) (π l ^ (eL l * E₀))` (the quotient of $W_l[[U,V]]$ by $UV-\pi_l^{e_lE_0}$) such that $\sigma(\pi_l)$ is the image of the constant $\varpi'_l$ whenever that constant lies in $\mathcal N_0(l)$, $\iota_c\circ\sigma$ is the constant map, the Igusa germ `jqNModC Qbar q` $-a_0$ lies in $\mathcal N_0(l)$ and is carried by $\iota_c$ to a unit times $V^e$ for some $e\ge1$, every constant from $C'_l$ lying in $\mathcal N_0(l)$ is in the image of $\sigma$, and the two tube readings hold: for $f\in\mathcal N_0(l)$ with $f\in$ `Rx.integers`, nonzero $R_x$-residue and $b_x.\mathrm{ord}$ equal to $n$, the image $\iota_c(f)$ differs from $\gamma V^n$ for some unit $\gamma$ by an element of the ideal generated by the constant $\pi_l$ and $U$; symmetrically, for $f\in$ `R.integers` with nonzero $R$-residue and $nd.\mathrm{ord}$ equal to $n$, $\iota_c(f)$ differs from $\gamma U^n$ by an element of the ideal generated by the constant $\pi_l$ and $V$.

Finally: for every $P\in S$ and every $f\in$ `R₀.integers` which has no pole at any place of $\mathcal M$ where `jq` has none and whose $R_0$-residue lies in the valuation subring of $s$, and for every $a\in A$ whose residue equals $s.\mathrm{evalAt}(R_0.\mathrm{residue}\,f)$, the difference $P.\mathrm{evalAt}(f)-a$ lies in $A$ and in its maximal ideal. Every $f\in$ `R₀.integers` has its image in $\mathcal F$ in `Rx.integers`. And there is a ring homomorphism $j$ from $\mathcal C$ to $F_I$ such that the $R_x$-residue of the image of every $f\in$ `R₀.integers` is $j$ of its $R_0$-residue, and such that $g\in\mathcal C$ lies in the valuation subring of $s$ if and only if $j(g)$ lies in that of $b_x$.

It is used by [`ModularCurve.FullLevel.klevel_nodeCore_nodeCharts_hasseGerm_nodeCentre_of_affineChart_poles_hasse_commonChart_nodes_igusaSep`](thm.html#ModularCurve.FullLevel.klevel_nodeCore_nodeCharts_hasseGerm_nodeCentre_of_affineChart_poles_hasse_commonChart_nodes_igusaSep), which assembles the per-node blocks over all $q+1$ nodes.

namespace VectorSpaceOpt

/-- The separating-hyperplane core of Luenberger, §9.4, Theorem 1. -/
theorem kkt_linearized_separator
    {X Z : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [NormedSpace ℝ Z]
    (P : ConvexCone ℝ Z) (xConstraint : Z)
    (f' : X →L[ℝ] ℝ) (G' : X →L[ℝ] Z)
    (hPint : (interior (P : Set Z)).Nonempty)
    (hfeas : coneLE P xConstraint 0)
    (hregular : ∃ h : X, coneLT P (xConstraint + G' h) 0)
    (hNoDescent : ¬ ∃ h : X, f' h < 0 ∧ coneLT P (xConstraint + G' h) 0) :
    ∃ z₀ : Z →L[ℝ] ℝ, dualPositive P z₀ ∧
      f' + z₀.comp G' = 0 ∧ z₀ xConstraint = 0 := by
  sorry

end VectorSpaceOpt
theorems.natural_language_statement:
Let `P` be a convex cone with nonempty interior in a normed real space `Z`. Fix a feasible constraint value, objective derivative `f'`, and constraint derivative `G'`. Assume a direction makes the linearized constraint strictly feasible, while no direction both makes it strictly feasible and gives negative objective derivative. Then there is a continuous linear functional `z₀` that is nonnegative on `P` and satisfies

$$f' + z₀ ∘ G' = 0, \qquad z₀(xConstraint)=0.$$

This milestone packages the functional-analytic separating-hyperplane core of Luenberger's theorem. It is independent of the nonlinear origin of `f'` and `G'`, so it can be reused for other cone-linearized necessary conditions and alternative differentiability frameworks.

theorems.theorem_title: Parking and the dilated region's split
theorems.natural_language_statement:
Parking and the dilated region's structure.

`dilPark`: from the round layout with no input left, retreating over the region's cells plus the home blank lands exactly on `ParkedTape` — the form the merge invariant and the whole simulation stack consume. The five separator blanks the last round left behind are simply absorbed into the ghost, which is what the ghost was introduced for.

`dilBlocks_split`: **on either track, a dilated region splits at its first block.** Only the first block carries flags — both virtual heads start at position zero — so `SplitAtFlag` holds for track A and track B with the same three-way split, the tail being flag-clear on both tracks (input blocks written flag-false, and the exit block flag-clear by construction). This is the fact the `HostsPair` for the dilated region rests on: track A will project to the input followed by blanks, track B to blanks throughout.

import Definitions.Def_sgl_dilation_pre

/-!
# The dilation, specified

Module G2's conclusion: `dilation i` turns a tape holding raw input bits into
the parked region hosting that input beside an empty track.

The three stages compose — pre-pass, loop, park — and the top-level read
dispatches the empty input to `initRegion` through `either`.
-/

namespace SipserGacsLautemann

variable {tapes : Nat}

/-- Parking: from the round invariant with no input left, retreat over the
region's cells to home. -/
theorem dilPark (blocks : List Block) (G : List TapeSymbol) :
    ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[(encodeBlocks blocks).length + 1])
        (dilTape blocks [] G) =
      ParkedTape blocks (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G) := by
  rw [dilTape, ParkedTape]
  have hbc : bitCells [] = [] := rfl
  rw [hbc, List.append_nil]
  have h := cellsTape_retreat (encodeBlocks blocks).reverse [TapeSymbol.blank]
    (List.replicate 4 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G) TapeSymbol.blank
  rw [List.length_reverse] at h
  rw [show List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G =
    TapeSymbol.blank :: (List.replicate 4 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G) from rfl]
  rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', h, List.reverse_reverse]
  obtain ⟨r, R, hcons⟩ : ∃ r R,
      encodeBlocks blocks ++ TapeSymbol.blank ::
        (List.replicate 4 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G) = r :: R := by
    cases hx : encodeBlocks blocks with
    | nil => exact ⟨TapeSymbol.blank, List.replicate 4 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G,
        by simp [hx]⟩
    | cons a as => exact ⟨a, as ++ TapeSymbol.blank ::
        (List.replicate 4 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G), by simp [hx]⟩
  rw [hcons, cellsTape_moveLeft, ← hcons]


/-! ## The blocks a full dilation writes -/

theorem dilSuffix_all (xs : List Bool) :
    dilSuffix xs true = encodeInputBlocks xs ∨ xs = [] := by
  cases xs with
  | nil => exact Or.inr rfl
  | cons x xs' =>
      refine Or.inl ?_
      rw [dilSuffix_nonempty_eq]
      rfl

/-- The region a non-empty input dilates to, with its cells. -/
theorem encodeInputBlocks_cons (x : Bool) (xs : List Bool) :
    encodeInputBlocks (x :: xs) = dilSuffix (x :: xs) true := by
  rw [dilSuffix_nonempty_eq]
  rfl

/-! ## Track projections of the dilated region

Both tracks are flagged only on the first block, so both split there.  Track A
then projects to the input followed by blanks — `PadEq` to the input tape —
and track B to blanks throughout. -/

theorem dilBlocks_flagA_first (x : Bool) (xs : List Bool) :
    TrackSide.A.getFlag (inputBlock x true) = true := rfl

theorem dilBlocks_flagB_first (x : Bool) (xs : List Bool) :
    TrackSide.B.getFlag (inputBlock x true) = true := rfl

theorem inputBlock_flagA_false (b : Bool) :
    TrackSide.A.getFlag (inputBlock b false) = false := rfl

theorem inputBlock_flagB_false (b : Bool) :
    TrackSide.B.getFlag (inputBlock b false) = false := rfl

@[simp] theorem exitBlock_flagA : TrackSide.A.getFlag exitBlock = false := rfl
@[simp] theorem exitBlock_flagB : TrackSide.B.getFlag exitBlock = false := rfl

/-- The tail of a dilated region carries no flags on either track. -/
theorem dilTail_clear (side : TrackSide) (xs : List Bool) :
    ∀ b ∈ (xs.map fun c => inputBlock c false) ++ [exitBlock],
      side.getFlag b = false := by
  intro b hb
  rcases List.mem_append.mp hb with h | h
  · obtain ⟨c, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
    cases side <;> rfl
  · rw [List.mem_singleton.mp h]
    cases side <;> rfl

/-- **The split of a dilated region**, on either track: at the first block. -/
theorem dilBlocks_split (side : TrackSide) (x : Bool) (xs : List Bool) :
    SplitAtFlag side (dilBlocks (x :: xs)) [] (inputBlock x true)
      ((xs.map fun c => inputBlock c false) ++ [exitBlock]) :=
  ⟨rfl, by intro b hb; simp at hb, by cases side <;> rfl,
    dilTail_clear side xs⟩

end SipserGacsLautemann

theorems.natural_language_statement:
The pre-pass: from the raw input tape to the first round's layout.

One left step materialises the home blank; one right step returns to position zero; the whole input is then shifted five right by the *same primitive the rounds use*, which simultaneously opens the first five-blank separator and leaves the head on home; a final right step lands on the separator start. `prePass_spec`: cost at most $15|{\rm rest}|+40$, ending exactly on the round invariant with no blocks written — which is what the loop consumes.

This is where the design collapse recorded earlier pays off: the planned shift-by-one pre-pass machine, with its own cycle and correctness proofs, was never needed. Shifting by five with the existing shifter does both jobs at once.

import Definitions.Def_sgl_dilation_loop

/-!
# The pre-pass

Module G2's last machine: from the raw input tape to the first round's layout.

One left step materialises the home blank; one right step returns to position
zero; then the whole input is shifted five right by the same primitive the
rounds use, which both creates the first five-blank separator and leaves the
head on home; a final right step lands on the separator start.
-/

namespace SipserGacsLautemann

variable {tapes : Nat}

theorem ofBits_eq_cellsTape (xs : List Bool) :
    Tape.ofBits xs = cellsTape [] (bitCells xs) := by
  cases xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs' => rfl

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
/-- Home, then position zero. -/
theorem prePass_enter (i : Fin tapes) (xs : List Bool) (G : List TapeSymbol)
    (T : Fin tapes → Tape)
    (hT : T i = cellsTape [] (bitCells xs ++ G)) :
    ((moveDir HeadMove.right) ((moveDir HeadMove.left) (T i))) =
      cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank] (bitCells xs ++ G) := by
  rw [hT]
  cases h : bitCells xs ++ G with
  | nil =>
      show moveDir HeadMove.right (moveDir HeadMove.left
        (cellsTape [] [])) = _
      rfl
  | cons c R =>
      show moveDir HeadMove.right (moveDir HeadMove.left
        (cellsTape [] (c :: R))) = _
      rw [show moveDir HeadMove.left (cellsTape [] (c :: R)) =
        cellsTape [] (TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: R) from rfl]
      rw [cellsTape_moveRight]


set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
/-- **The pre-pass on a non-empty input.**  Five blanks are opened before the
input and the head lands on the first separator: the round invariant with no
blocks written. -/
theorem prePass_spec (i : Fin tapes) (x : Bool) (rest : List Bool)
    (G : List TapeSymbol) (T : Fin tapes → Tape) (hG : AllBlank G)
    (hT : T i = cellsTape [] (bitCells (x :: rest) ++ G)) :
    ∃ (cost : Nat) (G' : List TapeSymbol), AllBlank G' ∧
      cost ≤ 15 * rest.length + 40 ∧
      HaltsExactly (prePass i) ((prePass i).startCfg T) cost true ∧
      (((prePass i).step^[cost]) ((prePass i).startCfg T)).tape =
        Function.update T i (dilTape [] (x :: rest) G') := by
  classical
  -- A: one left
  have hA := moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.left (by omega) T
  set T1 := Function.update T i ((moveDir HeadMove.left) (T i)) with hT1
  have hAt : (((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.left).step^[1])
      ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.left).startCfg T)).tape = T1 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 1 HeadMove.left (by omega) T, hT1]
    rfl
  -- B: one right, back to position zero
  have hB := moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) T1
  set T2 := Function.update T i
    (cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank] (bitCells (x :: rest) ++ G)) with hT2
  have hBt : (((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).step^[1])
      ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).startCfg T1)).tape = T2 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) T1, hT2, hT1]
    simp only [Function.update_idem, Function.update_self]
    congr 1
    rw [Function.iterate_one]
    exact prePass_enter i (x :: rest) G T hT
  have hT2i : T2 i =
      cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank] (bitCells (x :: rest) ++ G) := by
    rw [hT2]; simp
  -- C: scan right to the end of the input
  set d := rest.length with hd
  have hadv : ∀ k, k ≤ d →
      ((moveDir HeadMove.right)^[k + 1]) (T2 i) =
        cellsTape ((bitCells ((x :: rest).take (k + 1))).reverse ++
          [TapeSymbol.blank]) (bitCells ((x :: rest).drop (k + 1)) ++ G) := by
    intro k hk
    rw [hT2i]
    have hsplit : bitCells (x :: rest) ++ G =
        bitCells ((x :: rest).take (k + 1)) ++
          (bitCells ((x :: rest).drop (k + 1)) ++ G) := by
      rw [← List.append_assoc, ← bitCells_append, List.take_append_drop]
    have hlen : (bitCells ((x :: rest).take (k + 1))).length = k + 1 := by
      simp [bitCells, List.length_take]
      omega
    rw [hsplit]
    have hc := cellsTape_advance (bitCells ((x :: rest).take (k + 1)))
      [TapeSymbol.blank] (bitCells ((x :: rest).drop (k + 1)) ++ G)
    rw [hlen] at hc
    exact hc
  have hlt : ∀ k, k < d →
      (((moveDir HeadMove.right)^[k + 1]) (T2 i)).head ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    intro k hk
    rw [hadv k (by omega)]
    obtain ⟨y, ys, hdrop⟩ : ∃ y ys, (x :: rest).drop (k + 1) = y :: ys := by
      cases hdk : (x :: rest).drop (k + 1) with
      | nil =>
          exfalso
          have := congrArg List.length hdk
          simp [List.length_drop] at this
          omega
      | cons y ys => exact ⟨y, ys, rfl⟩
    rw [hdrop]
    simp [cellsTape]
  have heq : (((moveDir HeadMove.right)^[d + 1]) (T2 i)).head =
      TapeSymbol.blank := by
    rw [hadv d le_rfl]
    rw [show (x :: rest).drop (d + 1) = [] by
      rw [hd]; simp]
    exact cellsTape_head_allBlank _ G hG
  have hC := scanToBlank_spec_of i HeadMove.right T2 d hlt heq
  have hCt := scanToBlank_tape_of i HeadMove.right T2 d hlt heq
  set T3 := Function.update T2 i
    (cellsTape ((bitCells (x :: rest)).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) G)
    with hT3
  have hCt' : (((scanToBlank i HeadMove.right).step^[d * 4 + 3])
      ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.right).startCfg T2)).tape = T3 := by
    rw [hCt, hT3]
    show scanTapesDir T2 i HeadMove.right (d + 1) = _
    rw [scanTapesDir]
    congr 1
    rw [hadv d le_rfl]
    rw [show (x :: rest).drop (d + 1) = [] by rw [hd]; simp,
      show (x :: rest).take (d + 1) = x :: rest by rw [hd]; simp]
    simp
  have hT3i : T3 i =
      cellsTape ((bitCells (x :: rest)).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) G := by
    rw [hT3]; simp
  -- D: one left, onto the last input cell
  have hbc : (bitCells (x :: rest)).reverse =
      (bitCells (x :: rest)).reverse := rfl
  obtain ⟨lc, Lr, hLr⟩ : ∃ lc Lr,
      (bitCells (x :: rest)).reverse = lc :: Lr := by
    cases hrv : (bitCells (x :: rest)).reverse with
    | nil =>
        exfalso
        have := congrArg List.length hrv
        simp [bitCells] at this
    | cons a t => exact ⟨a, t, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨G₂, hG₂, hmv⟩ := moveDir_left_allBlank lc (Lr ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
    G hG
  have hD := moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.left (by omega) T3
  set T4 := Function.update T3 i
    (cellsTape (Lr ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) (lc :: G₂)) with hT4
  have hDt : (((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.left).step^[1])
      ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.left).startCfg T3)).tape = T4 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 1 HeadMove.left (by omega) T3, hT4]
    congr 1
    rw [Function.iterate_one, hT3i, hLr]
    show moveDir HeadMove.left
      (cellsTape (lc :: (Lr ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])) G) = _
    rw [hmv]
  have hT4i : T4 i = cellsTape (Lr ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) (lc :: G₂) := by
    rw [hT4]; simp
  -- E,F: the probe
  obtain ⟨cc, Lr2, hcL⟩ : ∃ cc Lr2, Lr ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] = cc :: Lr2 := by
    cases hL : Lr with
    | nil => exact ⟨TapeSymbol.blank, [], by simp⟩
    | cons a t => exact ⟨a, t ++ [TapeSymbol.blank], by simp⟩
  have hE := moveUpTo_spec i 5 HeadMove.right (by omega) T4
  set T5 := Function.update T4 i
    ((moveDir HeadMove.right)^[5] (T4 i)) with hT5
  have hEt : (((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.right).step^[5])
      ((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.right).startCfg T4)).tape = T5 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 5 HeadMove.right (by omega) T4, hT5]
  have hF := moveUpTo_spec i 5 HeadMove.left (by omega) T5
  set T6 := Function.update T5 i
    (cellsTape (Lr ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (lc :: List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5)) with hT6
  have hFt : (((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).step^[5])
      ((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).startCfg T5)).tape = T6 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 5 HeadMove.left (by omega) T5, hT6, hT5]
    simp only [Function.update_idem, Function.update_self]
    congr 1
    rw [hT4i, hcL]
    exact moveDir_probe5 cc lc Lr2 G₂ hG₂
  have hT6i : T6 i = cellsTape (Lr ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (lc :: List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5) := by
    rw [hT6]; simp
  -- G: the shift
  have hT6i' : T6 i = cellsTape (Lr ++ TapeSymbol.blank :: [])
      (lc :: List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5) := by
    rw [hT6i]
  have hLrnb : ∀ c ∈ Lr, c ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    intro c hc
    have : c ∈ (bitCells (x :: rest)).reverse := by
      rw [hLr]; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hc
    exact bitCells_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp this)
  have hlcnb : lc ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    have : lc ∈ (bitCells (x :: rest)).reverse := by rw [hLr]; simp
    exact bitCells_ne_blank _ lc (List.mem_reverse.mp this)
  obtain ⟨hGh, hGt⟩ := shiftSeg5_spec i Lr lc [] (G₂.drop 5) T6
    hlcnb hLrnb hT6i'
  set T7 := Function.update T6 i
    (cellsTape [] (TapeSymbol.blank ::
      List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ (Lr.reverse ++ lc :: G₂.drop 5)))
    with hT7
  have hGt' : (((shiftSeg5 i).step^[11 * (Lr.length + 1) + 1])
      ((shiftSeg5 i).startCfg T6)).tape = T7 := by
    rw [hGt, hT7]
  have hrev : Lr.reverse ++ lc :: G₂.drop 5 =
      bitCells (x :: rest) ++ G₂.drop 5 := by
    have h1 : (lc :: Lr).reverse = bitCells (x :: rest) := by
      rw [← hLr, List.reverse_reverse]
    have h2 : (lc :: Lr).reverse = Lr.reverse ++ [lc] := by simp
    rw [← h1, h2, List.append_assoc]
    rfl
  have hT7i : T7 i = cellsTape [] (TapeSymbol.blank ::
      List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
        (bitCells (x :: rest) ++ G₂.drop 5)) := by
    rw [hT7]
    simp only [Function.update_self]
    rw [hrev]
  -- H: one right, onto the separator start
  have hH := moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) T7
  set T8 := Function.update T7 i
    (cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank] (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
      (bitCells (x :: rest) ++ G₂.drop 5))) with hT8
  have hHt : (((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).step^[1])
      ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).startCfg T7)).tape = T8 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) T7, hT8]
    congr 1
    rw [Function.iterate_one, hT7i]
    exact cellsTape_moveRight [] TapeSymbol.blank _
  -- assemble
  have c7 := chainStepC hGh hGt' hH
  have c6 := chainStepC hF hFt c7.1
  have c5 := chainStepC hE hEt c6.1
  have c4 := chainStepC hD hDt c5.1
  have c3 := chainStepC hC hCt' c4.1
  have c2 := chainStepC hB hBt c3.1
  have c1 := chainStepC hA hAt c2.1
  refine ⟨1 + 1 + (1 + 1 + (d * 4 + 3 + 1 + (1 + 1 + (5 + 1 + (5 + 1 +
    ((11 * (Lr.length + 1) + 1) + 1 + 1)))))), G₂.drop 5, hG₂.drop 5,
    ?_, c1.1, ?_⟩
  · have hLrlen : Lr.length = rest.length := by
      have := congrArg List.length hLr
      simp [bitCells] at this
      omega
    rw [hLrlen, hd]
    omega
  · have hfin := c1.2
    rw [c2.2] at hfin
    rw [c3.2] at hfin
    rw [c4.2] at hfin
    rw [c5.2] at hfin
    rw [c6.2] at hfin
    rw [c7.2] at hfin
    have hfin' : ((prePass i).step^[1 + 1 + (1 + 1 + (d * 4 + 3 + 1 +
        (1 + 1 + (5 + 1 + (5 + 1 +
          ((11 * (Lr.length + 1) + 1) + 1 + 1))))))])
        ((prePass i).startCfg T) = _ := hfin
    rw [hfin']
    show (((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).step^[1])
      ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).startCfg T7)).tape = _
    rw [hHt, hT8, hT7, hT6, hT5, hT4, hT3, hT2]
    simp only [Function.update_idem]
    rw [dilTape]
    congr 1

end SipserGacsLautemann

The pre-pass: from the raw input tape to the first round's layout.

One left step materialises the home blank; one right step returns to position zero; the whole input is then shifted five right by the *same primitive the rounds use*, which simultaneously opens the first five-blank separator and leaves the head on home; a final right step lands on the separator start. `prePass_spec`: cost at most $15|{\rm rest}|+40$, ending exactly on the round invariant with no blocks written — which is what the loop consumes.

theorems.definition:
import Definitions.Def_sgl_dilation_loop

/-!
# The pre-pass

Module G2's last machine: from the raw input tape to the first round's layout.

One left step materialises the home blank; one right step returns to position
zero; then the whole input is shifted five right by the same primitive the
rounds use, which both creates the first five-blank separator and leaves the
head on home; a final right step lands on the separator start.
-/

namespace SipserGacsLautemann

variable {tapes : Nat}

theorem ofBits_eq_cellsTape (xs : List Bool) :
    Tape.ofBits xs = cellsTape [] (bitCells xs) := by
  cases xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs' => rfl

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
/-- Home, then position zero. -/
theorem prePass_enter (i : Fin tapes) (xs : List Bool) (G : List TapeSymbol)
    (T : Fin tapes → Tape)
    (hT : T i = cellsTape [] (bitCells xs ++ G)) :
    ((moveDir HeadMove.right) ((moveDir HeadMove.left) (T i))) =
      cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank] (bitCells xs ++ G) := by
  rw [hT]
  cases h : bitCells xs ++ G with
  | nil =>
      show moveDir HeadMove.right (moveDir HeadMove.left
        (cellsTape [] [])) = _
      rfl
  | cons c R =>
      show moveDir HeadMove.right (moveDir HeadMove.left
        (cellsTape [] (c :: R))) = _
      rw [show moveDir HeadMove.left (cellsTape [] (c :: R)) =
        cellsTape [] (TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: R) from rfl]
      rw [cellsTape_moveRight]


set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
/-- **The pre-pass on a non-empty input.**  Five blanks are opened before the
input and the head lands on the first separator: the round invariant with no
blocks written. -/
theorem prePass_spec (i : Fin tapes) (x : Bool) (rest : List Bool)
    (G : List TapeSymbol) (T : Fin tapes → Tape) (hG : AllBlank G)
    (hT : T i = cellsTape [] (bitCells (x :: rest) ++ G)) :
    ∃ (cost : Nat) (G' : List TapeSymbol), AllBlank G' ∧
      cost ≤ 15 * rest.length + 40 ∧
      HaltsExactly (prePass i) ((prePass i).startCfg T) cost true ∧
      (((prePass i).step^[cost]) ((prePass i).startCfg T)).tape =
        Function.update T i (dilTape [] (x :: rest) G') := by
  classical
  -- A: one left
  have hA := moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.left (by omega) T
  set T1 := Function.update T i ((moveDir HeadMove.left) (T i)) with hT1
  have hAt : (((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.left).step^[1])
      ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.left).startCfg T)).tape = T1 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 1 HeadMove.left (by omega) T, hT1]
    rfl
  -- B: one right, back to position zero
  have hB := moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) T1
  set T2 := Function.update T i
    (cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank] (bitCells (x :: rest) ++ G)) with hT2
  have hBt : (((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).step^[1])
      ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).startCfg T1)).tape = T2 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) T1, hT2, hT1]
    simp only [Function.update_idem, Function.update_self]
    congr 1
    rw [Function.iterate_one]
    exact prePass_enter i (x :: rest) G T hT
  have hT2i : T2 i =
      cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank] (bitCells (x :: rest) ++ G) := by
    rw [hT2]; simp
  -- C: scan right to the end of the input
  set d := rest.length with hd
  have hadv : ∀ k, k ≤ d →
      ((moveDir HeadMove.right)^[k + 1]) (T2 i) =
        cellsTape ((bitCells ((x :: rest).take (k + 1))).reverse ++
          [TapeSymbol.blank]) (bitCells ((x :: rest).drop (k + 1)) ++ G) := by
    intro k hk
    rw [hT2i]
    have hsplit : bitCells (x :: rest) ++ G =
        bitCells ((x :: rest).take (k + 1)) ++
          (bitCells ((x :: rest).drop (k + 1)) ++ G) := by
      rw [← List.append_assoc, ← bitCells_append, List.take_append_drop]
    have hlen : (bitCells ((x :: rest).take (k + 1))).length = k + 1 := by
      simp [bitCells, List.length_take]
      omega
    rw [hsplit]
    have hc := cellsTape_advance (bitCells ((x :: rest).take (k + 1)))
      [TapeSymbol.blank] (bitCells ((x :: rest).drop (k + 1)) ++ G)
    rw [hlen] at hc
    exact hc
  have hlt : ∀ k, k < d →
      (((moveDir HeadMove.right)^[k + 1]) (T2 i)).head ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    intro k hk
    rw [hadv k (by omega)]
    obtain ⟨y, ys, hdrop⟩ : ∃ y ys, (x :: rest).drop (k + 1) = y :: ys := by
      cases hdk : (x :: rest).drop (k + 1) with
      | nil =>
          exfalso
          have := congrArg List.length hdk
          simp [List.length_drop] at this
          omega
      | cons y ys => exact ⟨y, ys, rfl⟩
    rw [hdrop]
    simp [cellsTape]
  have heq : (((moveDir HeadMove.right)^[d + 1]) (T2 i)).head =
      TapeSymbol.blank := by
    rw [hadv d le_rfl]
    rw [show (x :: rest).drop (d + 1) = [] by
      rw [hd]; simp]
    exact cellsTape_head_allBlank _ G hG
  have hC := scanToBlank_spec_of i HeadMove.right T2 d hlt heq
  have hCt := scanToBlank_tape_of i HeadMove.right T2 d hlt heq
  set T3 := Function.update T2 i
    (cellsTape ((bitCells (x :: rest)).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) G)
    with hT3
  have hCt' : (((scanToBlank i HeadMove.right).step^[d * 4 + 3])
      ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.right).startCfg T2)).tape = T3 := by
    rw [hCt, hT3]
    show scanTapesDir T2 i HeadMove.right (d + 1) = _
    rw [scanTapesDir]
    congr 1
    rw [hadv d le_rfl]
    rw [show (x :: rest).drop (d + 1) = [] by rw [hd]; simp,
      show (x :: rest).take (d + 1) = x :: rest by rw [hd]; simp]
    simp
  have hT3i : T3 i =
      cellsTape ((bitCells (x :: rest)).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) G := by
    rw [hT3]; simp
  -- D: one left, onto the last input cell
  have hbc : (bitCells (x :: rest)).reverse =
      (bitCells (x :: rest)).reverse := rfl
  obtain ⟨lc, Lr, hLr⟩ : ∃ lc Lr,
      (bitCells (x :: rest)).reverse = lc :: Lr := by
    cases hrv : (bitCells (x :: rest)).reverse with
    | nil =>
        exfalso
        have := congrArg List.length hrv
        simp [bitCells] at this
    | cons a t => exact ⟨a, t, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨G₂, hG₂, hmv⟩ := moveDir_left_allBlank lc (Lr ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
    G hG
  have hD := moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.left (by omega) T3
  set T4 := Function.update T3 i
    (cellsTape (Lr ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) (lc :: G₂)) with hT4
  have hDt : (((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.left).step^[1])
      ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.left).startCfg T3)).tape = T4 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 1 HeadMove.left (by omega) T3, hT4]
    congr 1
    rw [Function.iterate_one, hT3i, hLr]
    show moveDir HeadMove.left
      (cellsTape (lc :: (Lr ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])) G) = _
    rw [hmv]
  have hT4i : T4 i = cellsTape (Lr ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) (lc :: G₂) := by
    rw [hT4]; simp
  -- E,F: the probe
  obtain ⟨cc, Lr2, hcL⟩ : ∃ cc Lr2, Lr ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] = cc :: Lr2 := by
    cases hL : Lr with
    | nil => exact ⟨TapeSymbol.blank, [], by simp⟩
    | cons a t => exact ⟨a, t ++ [TapeSymbol.blank], by simp⟩
  have hE := moveUpTo_spec i 5 HeadMove.right (by omega) T4
  set T5 := Function.update T4 i
    ((moveDir HeadMove.right)^[5] (T4 i)) with hT5
  have hEt : (((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.right).step^[5])
      ((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.right).startCfg T4)).tape = T5 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 5 HeadMove.right (by omega) T4, hT5]
  have hF := moveUpTo_spec i 5 HeadMove.left (by omega) T5
  set T6 := Function.update T5 i
    (cellsTape (Lr ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (lc :: List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5)) with hT6
  have hFt : (((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).step^[5])
      ((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).startCfg T5)).tape = T6 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 5 HeadMove.left (by omega) T5, hT6, hT5]
    simp only [Function.update_idem, Function.update_self]
    congr 1
    rw [hT4i, hcL]
    exact moveDir_probe5 cc lc Lr2 G₂ hG₂
  have hT6i : T6 i = cellsTape (Lr ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
      (lc :: List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5) := by
    rw [hT6]; simp
  -- G: the shift
  have hT6i' : T6 i = cellsTape (Lr ++ TapeSymbol.blank :: [])
      (lc :: List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5) := by
    rw [hT6i]
  have hLrnb : ∀ c ∈ Lr, c ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    intro c hc
    have : c ∈ (bitCells (x :: rest)).reverse := by
      rw [hLr]; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hc
    exact bitCells_ne_blank _ c (List.mem_reverse.mp this)
  have hlcnb : lc ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    have : lc ∈ (bitCells (x :: rest)).reverse := by rw [hLr]; simp
    exact bitCells_ne_blank _ lc (List.mem_reverse.mp this)
  obtain ⟨hGh, hGt⟩ := shiftSeg5_spec i Lr lc [] (G₂.drop 5) T6
    hlcnb hLrnb hT6i'
  set T7 := Function.update T6 i
    (cellsTape [] (TapeSymbol.blank ::
      List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ (Lr.reverse ++ lc :: G₂.drop 5)))
    with hT7
  have hGt' : (((shiftSeg5 i).step^[11 * (Lr.length + 1) + 1])
      ((shiftSeg5 i).startCfg T6)).tape = T7 := by
    rw [hGt, hT7]
  have hrev : Lr.reverse ++ lc :: G₂.drop 5 =
      bitCells (x :: rest) ++ G₂.drop 5 := by
    have h1 : (lc :: Lr).reverse = bitCells (x :: rest) := by
      rw [← hLr, List.reverse_reverse]
    have h2 : (lc :: Lr).reverse = Lr.reverse ++ [lc] := by simp
    rw [← h1, h2, List.append_assoc]
    rfl
  have hT7i : T7 i = cellsTape [] (TapeSymbol.blank ::
      List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
        (bitCells (x :: rest) ++ G₂.drop 5)) := by
    rw [hT7]
    simp only [Function.update_self]
    rw [hrev]
  -- H: one right, onto the separator start
  have hH := moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) T7
  set T8 := Function.update T7 i
    (cellsTape [TapeSymbol.blank] (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
      (bitCells (x :: rest) ++ G₂.drop 5))) with hT8
  have hHt : (((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).step^[1])
      ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).startCfg T7)).tape = T8 := by
    rw [moveUpTo_tape i 1 HeadMove.right (by omega) T7, hT8]
    congr 1
    rw [Function.iterate_one, hT7i]
    exact cellsTape_moveRight [] TapeSymbol.blank _
  -- assemble
  have c7 := chainStepC hGh hGt' hH
  have c6 := chainStepC hF hFt c7.1
  have c5 := chainStepC hE hEt c6.1
  have c4 := chainStepC hD hDt c5.1
  have c3 := chainStepC hC hCt' c4.1
  have c2 := chainStepC hB hBt c3.1
  have c1 := chainStepC hA hAt c2.1
  refine ⟨1 + 1 + (1 + 1 + (d * 4 + 3 + 1 + (1 + 1 + (5 + 1 + (5 + 1 +
    ((11 * (Lr.length + 1) + 1) + 1 + 1)))))), G₂.drop 5, hG₂.drop 5,
    ?_, c1.1, ?_⟩
  · have hLrlen : Lr.length = rest.length := by
      have := congrArg List.length hLr
      simp [bitCells] at this
      omega
    rw [hLrlen, hd]
    omega
  · have hfin := c1.2
    rw [c2.2] at hfin
    rw [c3.2] at hfin
    rw [c4.2] at hfin
    rw [c5.2] at hfin
    rw [c6.2] at hfin
    rw [c7.2] at hfin
    have hfin' : ((prePass i).step^[1 + 1 + (1 + 1 + (d * 4 + 3 + 1 +
        (1 + 1 + (5 + 1 + (5 + 1 +
          ((11 * (Lr.length + 1) + 1) + 1 + 1))))))])
        ((prePass i).startCfg T) = _ := hfin
    rw [hfin']
    show (((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).step^[1])
      ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).startCfg T7)).tape = _
    rw [hHt, hT8, hT7, hT6, hT5, hT4, hT3, hT2]
    simp only [Function.update_idem]
    rw [dilTape]
    congr 1

end SipserGacsLautemann

The loop consuming the remaining input, proved by induction over it. `dilLoop_run`: from any round configuration — head at the separator start, blocks so far to the left, remaining input compact to the right — the loop consumes the whole remainder and halts with every block appended, exit block last, at cost at most $(|{\rm rest}|+1)(15|{\rm rest}|+49)$: **quadratic in the input**, as in-place dilation must be.

The induction chains rounds through the loop algebra's single-round lemmas rather than the round-indexed trajectory apparatus, which needs one small general fact: `HaltsExactly.of_advance` — a halting fact composes across a configuration advance whose prefix is fresh. That is the whole bridge, and it is worth having separately: any loop proved by direct induction rather than through a `LoopRound` family will want it.

Also here: `dilSuffix`, the blocks a round-sequence writes from a given remainder, and its identification with the region `dilBlocks` for non-empty input.
theorems.definition:
import Definitions.Def_sgl_dilation_body

/-!
# The dilation loop

The loop consuming the remaining input, by induction over it.

`HaltsExactly.of_advance` is the small general bridge the induction needs: a
halting fact composes across a configuration advance whose prefix is fresh.
Any loop proved by direct induction rather than through a `LoopRound` family
will want it.
-/

namespace SipserGacsLautemann

variable {tapes : Nat}

/-! ## The loop -/

/-- Advancing a machine to a later configuration composes halting facts. -/
theorem HaltsExactly.of_advance {S : Type} {M : TypedMachine tapes S}
    {c₀ c₁ : TypedConfiguration tapes S} {k t : Nat} {v : Bool}
    (hadv : (M.step^[k]) c₀ = c₁)
    (hpre : ∀ j, j < k → M.result ((M.step^[j]) c₀).state = none)
    (h : HaltsExactly M c₁ t v) :
    HaltsExactly M c₀ (k + t) v := by
  constructor
  · rw [Nat.add_comm, Function.iterate_add_apply, hadv]
    exact h.halts
  · intro j hj
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j k with hlt | hge
    · exact hpre j hlt
    · obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hge
      rw [Nat.add_comm k d, Function.iterate_add_apply, hadv]
      exact h.fresh d (by omega)

/-- The blocks the loop writes from the remaining input, given the current
first-round flag. -/
def dilSuffix : List Bool → Bool → List Block
  | [], c => [blockFor (some TapeSymbol.blank) c]
  | x :: xs, c => inputBlock x c :: dilSuffix xs false

theorem dilSuffix_nonempty_eq (x : Bool) (xs : List Bool) :
    dilSuffix (x :: xs) true = dilBlocks (x :: xs) := by
  rw [dilBlocks]
  show inputBlock x true :: dilSuffix xs false = _
  congr 1
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons y ys ih =>
      show inputBlock y false :: dilSuffix ys false = _
      rw [ih]
      rfl

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
/-- **The dilation loop consumes the remaining input.**  From any round
configuration it halts with the remaining blocks (and the exit block)
appended, at quadratic cost. -/
theorem dilLoop_run (i : Fin tapes) :
    ∀ (xs : List Bool) (c : Bool) (done : List Block) (G : List TapeSymbol)
      (T : Fin tapes → Tape), AllBlank G → T i = dilTape done xs G →
      ∃ (cost : Nat) (G' : List TapeSymbol), AllBlank G' ∧
        cost ≤ (xs.length + 1) * (15 * xs.length + 49) ∧
        HaltsExactly (dilLoop i)
          (TypedConfiguration.inLoop c ⟨(dilBody i c).start, T⟩) cost false ∧
        ((((dilLoop i).step^[cost])
          (TypedConfiguration.inLoop c ⟨(dilBody i c).start, T⟩)).tape) =
          Function.update T i (dilTape (done ++ dilSuffix xs c) [] G') := by
  intro xs
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      intro c done G T hG hT
      obtain ⟨cb, G', hG', hcb, hhalt, hread, htape⟩ :=
        dilBody_spec_blank i c done G T hG hT
      have hstop : (fun _ b => !(isBitO (stateRead b))) c
          (((dilBody i c).step^[cb])
            ((dilBody i c).startCfg T)).state = true := by
        simp only [hread]
        rfl
      have hmain := TypedMachine.loopState_spec_v
        (fun first => dilBody i first) (fun _ _ => false)
        (fun _ b => !(isBitO (stateRead b))) (fun _ _ => false)
        true (fun _ => c)
        (fun _ => (dilBody i c).startCfg T) (fun _ => 0) 0 cb true
        (by intro j hj; omega) hhalt hstop
      have hmain' : HaltsExactly (dilLoop i)
          (TypedConfiguration.inLoop c ⟨(dilBody i c).start, T⟩) cb false := by
        have h := hmain
        simp only [loopCost, Nat.zero_add] at h
        exact h
      refine ⟨cb, G', hG', by simp; omega, hmain', ?_⟩
      · have hiter := TypedMachine.loopState_iterate_body
          (fun first => dilBody i first) (fun _ _ => false)
          (fun _ b => !(isBitO (stateRead b))) (fun _ _ => false)
          true c ((dilBody i c).startCfg T) cb hhalt.fresh
        show (((dilLoop i).step^[cb])
          (TypedConfiguration.inLoop c ((dilBody i c).startCfg T))).tape = _
        rw [dilLoop, hiter]
        show (((dilBody i c).step^[cb]) ((dilBody i c).startCfg T)).tape = _
        rw [htape]
        rfl
  | cons x rest ih =>
      intro c done G T hG hT
      obtain ⟨cb, G', hG', hcb, hhalt, hread, htape⟩ :=
        dilBody_spec_bit i c x done rest G T hG hT
      have hkeep : (fun _ b => !(isBitO (stateRead b))) c
          (((dilBody i c).step^[cb])
            ((dilBody i c).startCfg T)).state = false := by
        simp only [hread]
        rfl
      set T' := Function.update T i
        (dilTape (done ++ [inputBlock x c]) rest G') with hT'
      have hT'i : T' i = dilTape (done ++ [inputBlock x c]) rest G' := by
        rw [hT']; simp
      obtain ⟨ct, G'', hG'', hct, hhalt', htape'⟩ :=

        (fun first => dilBody i first) (fun _ _ => false)

        true (fun n => if n = 0 then c else false)
        (fun n => if n = 0 then (dilBody i c).startCfg T

import Definitions.Def_sgl_dilation_body

/-!
# The dilation loop

The loop consuming the remaining input, by induction over it.

`HaltsExactly.of_advance` is the small general bridge the induction needs: a
halting fact composes across a configuration advance whose prefix is fresh.
Any loop proved by direct induction rather than through a `LoopRound` family
will want it.
-/

namespace SipserGacsLautemann

variable {tapes : Nat}

/-! ## The loop -/

/-- Advancing a machine to a later configuration composes halting facts. -/
theorem HaltsExactly.of_advance {S : Type} {M : TypedMachine tapes S}
    {c₀ c₁ : TypedConfiguration tapes S} {k t : Nat} {v : Bool}
    (hadv : (M.step^[k]) c₀ = c₁)
    (hpre : ∀ j, j < k → M.result ((M.step^[j]) c₀).state = none)
    (h : HaltsExactly M c₁ t v) :
    HaltsExactly M c₀ (k + t) v := by
  constructor
  · rw [Nat.add_comm, Function.iterate_add_apply, hadv]
    exact h.halts
  · intro j hj
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j k with hlt | hge
    · exact hpre j hlt
    · obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hge
      rw [Nat.add_comm k d, Function.iterate_add_apply, hadv]
      exact h.fresh d (by omega)

/-- The blocks the loop writes from the remaining input, given the current
first-round flag. -/
def dilSuffix : List Bool → Bool → List Block
  | [], c => [blockFor (some TapeSymbol.blank) c]
  | x :: xs, c => inputBlock x c :: dilSuffix xs false

theorem dilSuffix_nonempty_eq (x : Bool) (xs : List Bool) :
    dilSuffix (x :: xs) true = dilBlocks (x :: xs) := by
  rw [dilBlocks]
  show inputBlock x true :: dilSuffix xs false = _
  congr 1
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons y ys ih =>
      show inputBlock y false :: dilSuffix ys false = _
      rw [ih]
      rfl

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
/-- **The dilation loop consumes the remaining input.**  From any round
configuration it halts with the remaining blocks (and the exit block)
appended, at quadratic cost. -/
theorem dilLoop_run (i : Fin tapes) :
    ∀ (xs : List Bool) (c : Bool) (done : List Block) (G : List TapeSymbol)
      (T : Fin tapes → Tape), AllBlank G → T i = dilTape done xs G →
      ∃ (cost : Nat) (G' : List TapeSymbol), AllBlank G' ∧
        cost ≤ (xs.length + 1) * (15 * xs.length + 49) ∧
        HaltsExactly (dilLoop i)
          (TypedConfiguration.inLoop c ⟨(dilBody i c).start, T⟩) cost false ∧
        ((((dilLoop i).step^[cost])
          (TypedConfiguration.inLoop c ⟨(dilBody i c).start, T⟩)).tape) =
          Function.update T i (dilTape (done ++ dilSuffix xs c) [] G') := by
  intro xs
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      intro c done G T hG hT
      obtain ⟨cb, G', hG', hcb, hhalt, hread, htape⟩ :=
        dilBody_spec_blank i c done G T hG hT
      have hstop : (fun _ b => !(isBitO (stateRead b))) c
          (((dilBody i c).step^[cb])
            ((dilBody i c).startCfg T)).state = true := by
        simp only [hread]
        rfl
      have hmain := TypedMachine.loopState_spec_v
        (fun first => dilBody i first) (fun _ _ => false)
        (fun _ b => !(isBitO (stateRead b))) (fun _ _ => false)
        true (fun _ => c)
        (fun _ => (dilBody i c).startCfg T) (fun _ => 0) 0 cb true
        (by intro j hj; omega) hhalt hstop
      have hmain' : HaltsExactly (dilLoop i)
          (TypedConfiguration.inLoop c ⟨(dilBody i c).start, T⟩) cb false := by
        simpa [loopCost] using hmain
      refine ⟨cb, G', hG', by simp; omega, hmain', ?_⟩
      · have hiter := TypedMachine.loopState_iterate_body
          (fun first => dilBody i first) (fun _ _ => false)
          (fun _ b => !(isBitO (stateRead b))) (fun _ _ => false)
          true c ((dilBody i c).startCfg T) cb hhalt.fresh
        show (((dilLoop i).step^[cb])
          (TypedConfiguration.inLoop c ((dilBody i c).startCfg T))).tape = _
        rw [dilLoop, hiter]
        show (((dilBody i c).step^[cb]) ((dilBody i c).startCfg T)).tape = _
        rw [htape]
        rfl
  | cons x rest ih =>
      intro c done G T hG hT
      obtain ⟨cb, G', hG', hcb, hhalt, hread, htape⟩ :=
        dilBody_spec_bit i c x done rest G T hG hT
      have hkeep : (fun _ b => !(isBitO (stateRead b))) c
          (((dilBody i c).step^[cb])
            ((dilBody i c).startCfg T)).state = false := by
        simp only [hread]
        rfl
      set T' := Function.update T i
        (dilTape (done ++ [inputBlock x c]) rest G') with hT'
      have hT'i : T' i = dilTape (done ++ [inputBlock x c]) rest G' := by
        rw [hT']; simp
      obtain ⟨ct, G'', hG'', hct, hhalt', htape'⟩ :=
        ih false (done ++ [inputBlock x c]) G' T' hG' hT'i
      -- one round advances the loop
      have hround := TypedMachine.loopState_round
        (fun first => dilBody i first) (fun _ _ => false)
        (fun _ b => !(isBitO (stateRead b))) (fun _ _ => false)
        true (fun n => if n = 0 then c else false)
        (fun n => if n = 0 then (dilBody i c).startCfg T
          else (dilBody i false).startCfg T')
        (fun _ => cb) 0
        ⟨⟨true, by simpa using hhalt⟩, by simpa using hkeep, by simp,
          by
            simp only [if_pos rfl, if_neg (Nat.zero_ne_one ∘ Eq.symm)]
            show ((dilBody i false).startCfg T' :
                TypedConfiguration tapes _) =
              ⟨(dilBody i false).start,
                (((dilBody i c).step^[cb]) ((dilBody i c).startCfg T)).tape⟩
            rw [htape]
            rfl⟩
      have hfresh := TypedMachine.loopState_round_fresh
        (fun first => dilBody i first) (fun _ _ => false)
        (fun _ b => !(isBitO (stateRead b))) (fun _ _ => false)
        true c ((dilBody i c).startCfg T) cb true hhalt hkeep
      have hadv : ((dilLoop i).step^[cb + 1])
          (TypedConfiguration.inLoop c ⟨(dilBody i c).start, T⟩) =
          TypedConfiguration.inLoop false ⟨(dilBody i false).start, T'⟩ := by
        have := hround
        simpa using this
      refine ⟨cb + 1 + ct, G'', hG'', ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have h1 : cb + 1 ≤ 15 * rest.length + 49 := by omega
        have h2 : ct ≤ (rest.length + 1) * (15 * rest.length + 49) := hct
        have h3 : (rest.length + 1) * (15 * rest.length + 49) ≤
            (rest.length + 1) * (15 * (rest.length + 1) + 49) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
        have h4 : ((x :: rest).length + 1) * (15 * (x :: rest).length + 49) =
            (rest.length + 2) * (15 * (rest.length + 1) + 49) := by
          simp [List.length_cons]
        rw [h4]
        have h5 : (rest.length + 2) * (15 * (rest.length + 1) + 49) =
            (rest.length + 1) * (15 * (rest.length + 1) + 49) +
              (15 * (rest.length + 1) + 49) := by
          rw [Nat.succ_mul]
        omega
      · exact HaltsExactly.of_advance hadv
          (fun j hj => hfresh j hj) hhalt'
      · rw [show cb + 1 + ct = ct + (cb + 1) by omega,
          Function.iterate_add_apply, hadv, htape', hT']
        simp only [Function.update_idem]
        rw [show done ++ dilSuffix (x :: rest) c =
          (done ++ [inputBlock x c]) ++ dilSuffix rest false by
            rw [List.append_assoc]
            rfl]

end SipserGacsLautemann

theorems.natural_language_statement:
The in-place dilation machine and the proved core of its round.

`dilation i` converts a tape holding raw input bits into the parked two-track region hosting that input beside an empty track — the initialization `eliminate_last_scratch_tape` needs, forced by the three-symbol alphabet. Structure: a one-step read dispatches empty input to `initRegion` through the new `TypedMachine.either` combinator (branches of *different state types* run on their sum — the missing dispatch primitive); otherwise a pre-pass shifts the whole input five right, and a `loopState` round harvests one cell, shifts the remainder five right, and writes one six-cell block over the five separators plus the harvested cell. A round that reads blank writes the all-blank flag-clear `exitBlock` — `PadEq` absorbs it — and the loop stops on the symbol captured in the terminal state, read by the generic `stateRead` peel.

**`dilCont_spec_bit`, proved in both branches, is the phase's centerpiece**: the post-read chain — scan right, step back, probe, shift, five left, write — runs in at most $15|{\rm rest}| + 40$ steps and lands exactly on the next round's invariant, the head at the new separator start over blocks-so-far extended by the new block. The empty-remainder branch runs the same chain with the shifter halting at once, which is what makes the loop's last round uniform with the others.

One elaboration point worth recording: `writeRun`'s state type carries the cell list's length, so a family over the captured symbol is only type-uniform because `Block.toCells` is a literal six-cell list — its length reduces definitionally even on stuck arguments. The `dilWrite` wrapper pins that down once.
theorems.definition:
import Definitions.Def_sgl_machine_either

/-!
# In-place input dilation

Module G2 of DESIGN_finish_mission: convert a tape holding raw input bits into
the parked two-track region hosting (that input, the empty scratch tape).

Layout invariant before round `i` (head at the separator start, position
`6(i−1)` relative to the block region's origin): blocks written so far to the
left, five blank separators under and right of the head, the next input cell
five right, the compact remainder after it, blanks beyond.  One round harvests
the cell, shifts the remainder five right (vacating the next separators),
and writes the six-cell block over the old separators plus the harvested cell.

A round that reads blank instead of an input bit writes the all-blank
`exitBlock` (flags clear — `PadEq` absorbs it) and the loop stops on the
captured symbol.  The empty input never enters the loop: a top-level read
dispatches it to `initRegion` through `TypedMachine.either`.
-/

namespace SipserGacsLautemann

variable {tapes : Nat}

/-- The block hosting one input cell on track A, empty track B. -/
def inputBlock (b : Bool) (first : Bool) : Block :=
  ⟨TapeSymbol.bit b, first, TapeSymbol.blank, first⟩

/-- The block a blank read writes: both tracks blank, flags clear. -/
def exitBlock : Block :=
  ⟨TapeSymbol.blank, false, TapeSymbol.blank, false⟩

/-- The block a round writes, from the captured symbol. -/
def blockFor (rec : Option TapeSymbol) (first : Bool) : Block :=
  match rec with
  | some (TapeSymbol.bit b) => inputBlock b first
  | _ => ⟨TapeSymbol.blank, first, TapeSymbol.blank, first⟩

/-- The region the dilation builds for a *non-empty* input. -/
def dilBlocks : List Bool → List Block
  | [] => [exitBlock]
  | x :: xs => inputBlock x true ::
      (xs.map fun b => inputBlock b false) ++ [exitBlock]

/-- The region for arbitrary input (empty input gets the merge-init block). -/
def encodeInputBlocks (xs : List Bool) : List Block :=
  match xs with
  | [] => [initBlock]
  | _ => dilBlocks xs

/-- Input bits as tape symbols. -/
def bitCells (xs : List Bool) : List TapeSymbol :=
  xs.map fun b => TapeSymbol.bit b

/-- The round invariant: head at the separator start. -/
def dilTape (done : List Block) (rest : List Bool) (G : List TapeSymbol) :
    Tape :=
  cellsTape ((encodeBlocks done).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
    (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ bitCells rest ++ G)

/-! ## The machines -/

/-- Read the head symbol, erase it, stay. -/
def eraseRead (i : Fin tapes) :=
  TypedMachine.readAct (fun syms =>
    (syms i,
      fun j => (if j = i then TapeSymbol.blank else syms j, HeadMove.stay)))

/-- The block write, at its reduced state type. -/
def dilWrite (i : Fin tapes) (rec : Option TapeSymbol) (first : Bool) :
    TypedMachine tapes (Fin 7) :=
  writeRun i (Block.toCells (blockFor rec first))

/-- The post-read chain of one round. -/
def dilCont (i : Fin tapes) (rec : Option TapeSymbol) (first : Bool) :=
  (scanToBlank i HeadMove.right).andThen fun _ =>
    (moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.left).andThen fun _ =>
      (moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.right).andThen fun _ =>
        (moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).andThen fun _ =>
          (shiftSeg5 i).andThen fun _ =>
            (moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).andThen fun _ =>
              dilWrite i rec first

/-- One dilation round. -/
def dilBody (i : Fin tapes) (first : Bool) :=
  (moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.right).andThen fun _ =>
    (eraseRead i).andThenState (fun s => s.isSome) fun rec =>
      dilCont i rec first

/-- Recover the captured symbol from a terminal body state (generic in the
layers around the `andThenState` junction). -/
def stateRead {S₁ S₂ : Type}
    (s : S₁ ⊕ Bool × (Option TapeSymbol ⊕ Option TapeSymbol × S₂)) :
    Option TapeSymbol :=
  match s with
  | .inr (_, .inr (rec, _)) => rec
  | _ => none

@[simp] theorem stateRead_inr {S₁ S₂ : Type} (b : Bool)
    (rec : Option TapeSymbol) (s : S₂) :
    stateRead (S₁ := S₁) (Sum.inr (b, Sum.inr (rec, s))) = rec := rfl

/-- Was the captured symbol an input bit? -/
def isBitO : Option TapeSymbol → Bool
  | some (TapeSymbol.bit _) => true
  | _ => false

/-- The dilation loop: run rounds while the read is an input bit. -/
def dilLoop (i : Fin tapes) :=
  TypedMachine.loopState (fun first => dilBody i first)
    (fun _ _ => false)
    (fun _ b => !(isBitO (stateRead b)))
    (fun _ _ => false)
    true

/-- The pre-pass: materialise home, shift the whole input right by five. -/
def prePass (i : Fin tapes) :=
  (moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.left).andThen fun _ =>
    (moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).andThen fun _ =>
      (scanToBlank i HeadMove.right).andThen fun _ =>
        (moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.left).andThen fun _ =>
          (moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.right).andThen fun _ =>
            (moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).andThen fun _ =>
              (shiftSeg5 i).andThen fun _ =>
                moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right

/-- The whole non-empty path: pre-pass, loop, park. -/
def dilMain (i : Fin tapes) :=
  (prePass i).andThen fun _ =>
    (dilLoop i).andThen fun _ =>
      scanToBlank i HeadMove.left

/-- **The dilation machine**: dispatch on the first cell. -/
def dilation (i : Fin tapes) :=
  (TypedMachine.readAct (fun syms =>
      (syms i, fun j => (syms j, HeadMove.stay)))).andThenState
    (fun s => s.isSome) fun rec =>
      (dilMain i).either (initRegion i) (isBitO rec)


/-! ## Support lemmas -/

/-- The shifter on a blank head: one step, halt, tape unchanged. -/
theorem shiftSeg5_halt_spec (i : Fin tapes) (T : Fin tapes → Tape)
    (hb : (T i).head = TapeSymbol.blank) :
    HaltsExactly (shiftSeg5 i) ((shiftSeg5 i).startCfg T) 1 false ∧
    (((shiftSeg5 i).step^[1]) ((shiftSeg5 i).startCfg T)).tape = T := by
  have hstep : ((shiftSeg5 i).step^[1]) ((shiftSeg5 i).startCfg T) =
      ⟨(⟨11, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T⟩ := by
    rw [Function.iterate_one]
    exact shiftSeg5_step_halt i T hb
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [hstep]; rfl
  · intro j hj
    have : j = 0 := by omega
    subst this
    rfl
  · rw [hstep]

/-- The erase-read's tape action. -/
theorem applyAction_erase (i : Fin tapes) (T : Fin tapes → Tape) :
    applyAction T (fun syms j =>
        (if j = i then TapeSymbol.blank else syms j, HeadMove.stay)) =
      Function.update T i (Tape.write (T i) TapeSymbol.blank) := by
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst hj
    simp [applyAction, Tape.move]
  · simp [applyAction, hj, Tape.write_head_self, Tape.move]

/-- A tape parked over an all-blank right context reads blank. -/
theorem cellsTape_head_allBlank (L G : List TapeSymbol) (hG : AllBlank G) :
    (cellsTape L G).head = TapeSymbol.blank := by
  cases G with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons g G' => exact hG g (by simp)

/-- Five retreats over the separator cells. -/
theorem retreat5 (L R : List TapeSymbol) (r : TapeSymbol) :
    ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[5])
        (cellsTape (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ L) (r :: R)) =
      cellsTape L (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ r :: R) := by
  have h := cellsTape_retreat (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank) L R r
  simpa using h

@[simp] theorem bitCells_ne_blank (xs : List Bool) :
    ∀ c ∈ bitCells xs, c ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
  intro c hc
  simp only [bitCells, List.mem_map] at hc
  obtain ⟨b, -, rfl⟩ := hc
  simp

@[simp] theorem bitCells_nil : bitCells [] = [] := rfl

@[simp] theorem bitCells_cons (x : Bool) (xs : List Bool) :
    bitCells (x :: xs) = TapeSymbol.bit x :: bitCells xs := rfl

theorem bitCells_append (xs ys : List Bool) :
    bitCells (xs ++ ys) = bitCells xs ++ bitCells ys := by
  simp [bitCells]

theorem encodeBlocks_snoc (bs : List Block) (b : Block) :
    encodeBlocks (bs ++ [b]) = encodeBlocks bs ++ Block.toCells b := by
  rw [encodeBlocks_append]
  simp


/-! ## Left-move over an all-blank right context -/

theorem moveDir_left_allBlank (c : TapeSymbol) (L R : List TapeSymbol)
    (hR : AllBlank R) :
    ∃ R₂, AllBlank R₂ ∧
      moveDir HeadMove.left (cellsTape (c :: L) R) = cellsTape L (c :: R₂) := by
  cases R with
  | nil =>
      exact ⟨[TapeSymbol.blank], AllBlank.single, cellsTape_moveLeft_nil L c⟩
  | cons r R' =>
      exact ⟨r :: R', hR, cellsTape_moveLeft L c r R'⟩

set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
/-- **The post-read chain on an input bit**: shift the remainder five right,
write the block, land at the next separator start over the round invariant. -/
theorem dilCont_spec_bit (i : Fin tapes) (first x : Bool)
    (done : List Block) (rest : List Bool) (G : List TapeSymbol)
    (T2 : Fin tapes → Tape) (hG : AllBlank G)
    (hT2 : T2 i = cellsTape
      (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
        ((encodeBlocks done).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (TapeSymbol.blank :: bitCells rest ++ G)) :
    ∃ (cost : Nat) (G' : List TapeSymbol), AllBlank G' ∧
      cost ≤ 15 * rest.length + 40 ∧
      HaltsExactly (dilCont i (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first)
        ((dilCont i (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first).startCfg T2) cost true ∧
      (((dilCont i (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first).step^[cost])
        ((dilCont i (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first).startCfg T2)).tape =
        Function.update T2 i (cellsTape
          ((encodeBlocks (done ++ [inputBlock x first])).reverse ++
            [TapeSymbol.blank])
          (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ bitCells rest ++ G')) := by
  classical
  set L0 := (encodeBlocks done).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] with hL0
  set L2 := List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ L0 with hL2
  set d := rest.length with hd
  -- ===== stage C: scan right over the remainder =====
  have hadv : ∀ k, k ≤ d →
      ((moveDir HeadMove.right)^[k + 1]) (T2 i) =
        cellsTape ((TapeSymbol.blank :: bitCells (rest.take k)).reverse ++ L2)
          (bitCells (rest.drop k) ++ G) := by
    intro k hk
    have hsplit : TapeSymbol.blank :: bitCells rest ++ G =
        (TapeSymbol.blank :: bitCells (rest.take k)) ++
          (bitCells (rest.drop k) ++ G) := by
      rw [show TapeSymbol.blank :: bitCells (rest.take k) ++
          (bitCells (rest.drop k) ++ G) =
        TapeSymbol.blank :: (bitCells (rest.take k) ++ bitCells (rest.drop k))
          ++ G by simp]
      rw [← bitCells_append, List.take_append_drop]
    have hlen : (TapeSymbol.blank :: bitCells (rest.take k)).length = k + 1 := by
      simp [bitCells, List.length_take]
      omega
    rw [hT2, hsplit, ← hlen, cellsTape_advance]
  have hlt : ∀ k, k < d →
      (((moveDir HeadMove.right)^[k + 1]) (T2 i)).head ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    intro k hk
    rw [hadv k (by omega)]
    obtain ⟨y, ys, hdrop⟩ : ∃ y ys, rest.drop k = y :: ys := by

    simp [cellsTape]

      TapeSymbol.blank := by
    rw [hadv d le_rfl]
    rw [show rest.drop d = [] by rw [hd]; exact List.drop_length]
    exact cellsTape_head_allBlank _ G hG
  have hC := scanToBlank_spec_of i HeadMove.right T2 d hlt heq
  have hCt := scanToBlank_tape_of i HeadMove.right T2 d hlt heq
  set T3 := Function.update T2 i
    (cellsTape ((bitCells rest).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] ++ L2) G)

      ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.right).startCfg T2)).tape = T3 := by
    rw [hCt, hT3]
    show scanTapesDir T2 i HeadMove.right (d + 1) = _
    rw [scanTapesDir]
    congr 1
    rw [hadv d le_rfl]
    rw [show rest.drop d = [] by rw [hd]; exact List.drop_length,
      show rest.take d = rest by rw [hd]; exact List.take_length]
    simp

      cellsTape ((bitCells rest).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] ++ L2) G := by
    rw [hT3]; simp
  -- ===== stages D–I, by the shape of the remainder =====
  rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat rest with hrest | ⟨ws, w, hrest⟩
  case inl =>
    subst hrest
    -- ----- D: one left -----
    obtain ⟨G₂, hG₂, hmv⟩ := moveDir_left_allBlank TapeSymbol.blank L2 G hG
