        ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.left).startCfg T3)).tape = T4 := by
      rw [moveUpTo_tape i 1 HeadMove.left (by omega) T3, hT4]
      congr 1
      rw [Function.iterate_one, hT3i]
      show moveDir HeadMove.left
        (cellsTape (TapeSymbol.blank :: L2) G) = _
      rw [hmv]
    have hT4i : T4 i = cellsTape L2 (TapeSymbol.blank :: G₂) := by
      rw [hT4]; simp
    -- ----- E,F: the probe -----
    have hE := moveUpTo_spec i 5 HeadMove.right (by omega) T4
    set T5 := Function.update T4 i
      ((moveDir HeadMove.right)^[5] (T4 i)) with hT5
    have hEt : (((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.right).step^[5])
        ((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.right).startCfg T4)).tape = T5 := by
      rw [moveUpTo_tape i 5 HeadMove.right (by omega) T4, hT5]
    have hF := moveUpTo_spec i 5 HeadMove.left (by omega) T5
    set T6 := Function.update T5 i
      (cellsTape L2 (TapeSymbol.blank ::
        List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5)) with hT6
    have hFt : (((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).step^[5])
        ((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).startCfg T5)).tape = T6 := by
      rw [moveUpTo_tape i 5 HeadMove.left (by omega) T5, hT6, hT5]
      simp only [Function.update_idem, Function.update_self]
      congr 1
      rw [hT4i, hL2]
      show ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[5])
        (((moveDir HeadMove.right)^[5]) (cellsTape
          (TapeSymbol.blank :: (List.replicate 4 TapeSymbol.blank ++ L0))
          (TapeSymbol.blank :: G₂))) = _
      rw [moveDir_probe5 TapeSymbol.blank TapeSymbol.blank _ G₂ hG₂]
      rfl

        List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5) := by
      rw [hT6]; simp

    obtain ⟨hGh, hGt⟩ := shiftSeg5_halt_spec i T6 (by rw [hT6i]; rfl)
    -- ----- H: five left -----
    have hH := moveUpTo_spec i 5 HeadMove.left (by omega) T6
    set T7 := Function.update T6 i
      (cellsTape L0 (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ TapeSymbol.blank ::
        List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5)) with hT7
    have hHt : (((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).step^[5])
        ((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).startCfg T6)).tape = T7 := by
      rw [moveUpTo_tape i 5 HeadMove.left (by omega) T6, hT7]
      congr 1
      rw [hT6i, hL2]
      exact retreat5 L0 _ TapeSymbol.blank
    have hT7i : T7 i = cellsTape L0
        (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ TapeSymbol.blank ::
          List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5) := by
      rw [hT7]; simp
    -- ----- I: write the block -----
    have hI := writeRun_spec i
      (Block.toCells (blockFor (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first)) T7 _ _ hT7i
    have hIt := writeRun_tape i
      (Block.toCells (blockFor (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first)) T7 _ _ hT7i
    -- ----- assemble -----
    have c6 := chainStepC hH hHt hI
    have c5 := chainStepC hGh hGt c6.1
    have c4 := chainStepC hF hFt c5.1
    have c4a := chainStepC hE hEt c4.1
    have c3 := chainStepC hD hDt c4a.1
    have c2 := chainStepC hC hCt' c3.1
    refine ⟨d * 4 + 3 + 1 + (1 + 1 + (5 + 1 + (5 + 1 + (1 + 1 +
      (5 + 1 + 6))))), G₂.drop 5, hG₂.drop 5, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hd0 : d = 0 := by rw [hd]; rfl
      omega
    · exact c2.1
    · have hfin := c2.2
      rw [c3.2] at hfin
      rw [c4a.2] at hfin
      rw [c4.2] at hfin
      rw [c5.2] at hfin
      rw [c6.2] at hfin
      have hfin' : ((dilCont i (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first).step^[
          d * 4 + 3 + 1 + (1 + 1 + (5 + 1 + (5 + 1 + (1 + 1 +
            (5 + 1 + 6)))))])
          ((dilCont i (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first).startCfg T2) = _ :=
        hfin
      rw [hfin']
      show (((writeRun i (Block.toCells (blockFor (some (TapeSymbol.bit x))
          first))).step^[(Block.toCells (blockFor (some (TapeSymbol.bit x))
          first)).length]) ((writeRun i (Block.toCells (blockFor
          (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first))).startCfg T7)).tape = _
      rw [hIt]
      rw [hT7, hT6, hT5, hT4, hT3]
      simp only [Function.update_idem]
      congr 1
      rw [show (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ TapeSymbol.blank ::
          List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5).drop
            (Block.toCells (blockFor (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first)).length =
          List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5 by
        rw [Block.toCells_length]
        rfl]
      rw [hL0, show blockFor (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first =

      rw [show (Block.toCells (inputBlock x first)).reverse ++
          ((encodeBlocks done).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) =
        (encodeBlocks (done ++ [inputBlock x first])).reverse ++
          [TapeSymbol.blank] by
        rw [encodeBlocks_snoc, List.reverse_append]
        simp]

  case inr =>
    rw [List.concat_eq_append] at hrest
    subst hrest
    have hbc : (bitCells (ws ++ [w])).reverse =
        TapeSymbol.bit w :: (bitCells ws).reverse := by
      rw [bitCells_append]
      simp
    -- ----- D: one left, onto the remainder's last cell -----
    obtain ⟨G₂, hG₂, hmv⟩ := moveDir_left_allBlank (TapeSymbol.bit w)
      ((bitCells ws).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] ++ L2) G hG
    have hD := moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.left (by omega) T3
    set T4 := Function.update T3 i
      (cellsTape ((bitCells ws).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] ++ L2)
        (TapeSymbol.bit w :: G₂)) with hT4
    have hDt : (((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.left).step^[1])
        ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.left).startCfg T3)).tape = T4 := by
      rw [moveUpTo_tape i 1 HeadMove.left (by omega) T3, hT4]
      congr 1
      rw [Function.iterate_one, hT3i, hbc]
      show moveDir HeadMove.left (cellsTape (TapeSymbol.bit w ::
        ((bitCells ws).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] ++ L2)) G) = _
      rw [hmv]
    have hT4i : T4 i = cellsTape
        ((bitCells ws).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] ++ L2)
        (TapeSymbol.bit w :: G₂) := by
      rw [hT4]; simp
    -- ----- E,F: the probe -----
    obtain ⟨cc, Lr, hcL⟩ : ∃ cc Lr,
        (bitCells ws).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] ++ L2 = cc :: Lr := by
      cases hws : (bitCells ws).reverse with
      | nil => exact ⟨TapeSymbol.blank, L2, by simp⟩
      | cons a t => exact ⟨a, t ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] ++ L2, by simp⟩
    have hE := moveUpTo_spec i 5 HeadMove.right (by omega) T4
    set T5 := Function.update T4 i
      ((moveDir HeadMove.right)^[5] (T4 i)) with hT5
    have hEt : (((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.right).step^[5])
        ((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.right).startCfg T4)).tape = T5 := by
      rw [moveUpTo_tape i 5 HeadMove.right (by omega) T4, hT5]
    have hF := moveUpTo_spec i 5 HeadMove.left (by omega) T5
    set T6 := Function.update T5 i
      (cellsTape ((bitCells ws).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] ++ L2)
        (TapeSymbol.bit w ::
          List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5)) with hT6
    have hFt : (((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).step^[5])
        ((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).startCfg T5)).tape = T6 := by
      rw [moveUpTo_tape i 5 HeadMove.left (by omega) T5, hT6, hT5]
      simp only [Function.update_idem, Function.update_self]
      congr 1
      rw [hT4i, hcL]
      exact moveDir_probe5 cc (TapeSymbol.bit w) Lr G₂ hG₂
    have hT6i : T6 i = cellsTape
        ((bitCells ws).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] ++ L2)
        (TapeSymbol.bit w ::
          List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5) := by
      rw [hT6]; simp
    -- ----- G: the shift -----
    have hT6i' : T6 i = cellsTape
        ((bitCells ws).reverse ++ TapeSymbol.blank :: L2)
        (TapeSymbol.bit w ::
          List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5) := by
      rw [hT6i]
      congr 1
      simp
    obtain ⟨hGh, hGt⟩ := shiftSeg5_spec i (bitCells ws).reverse
      (TapeSymbol.bit w) L2 (G₂.drop 5) T6 (by simp)
      (fun c hc => bitCells_ne_blank ws c (List.mem_reverse.mp hc)) hT6i'
    -- ----- H: five left -----
    set T7g := Function.update T6 i
      (cellsTape L2 (TapeSymbol.blank ::
        List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
          ((bitCells ws).reverse.reverse ++ TapeSymbol.bit w ::

      rw [hGt, hT7g]
    have hT7gi : T7g i = cellsTape L2 (TapeSymbol.blank ::
        List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
          (bitCells (ws ++ [w]) ++ G₂.drop 5)) := by
      rw [hT7g]
      simp only [Function.update_self]
      congr 2
      rw [List.reverse_reverse, bitCells_append]
      simp
    have hH := moveUpTo_spec i 5 HeadMove.left (by omega) T7g
    set T8 := Function.update T7g i
      (cellsTape L0 (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ TapeSymbol.blank ::
        List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
          (bitCells (ws ++ [w]) ++ G₂.drop 5))) with hT8

        ((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).startCfg T7g)).tape = T8 := by
      rw [moveUpTo_tape i 5 HeadMove.left (by omega) T7g, hT8]
      congr 1
      rw [hT7gi, hL2]
      exact retreat5 L0 _ TapeSymbol.blank
    have hT8i : T8 i = cellsTape L0
        (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ TapeSymbol.blank ::
          List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
            (bitCells (ws ++ [w]) ++ G₂.drop 5)) := by
      rw [hT8]; simp
    -- ----- I: write the block -----
    have hI := writeRun_spec i
      (Block.toCells (blockFor (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first)) T8 _ _ hT8i
    have hIt := writeRun_tape i
      (Block.toCells (blockFor (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first)) T8 _ _ hT8i
    -- ----- assemble -----
    have c6 := chainStepC hH hHt hI
    have c5 := chainStepC hGh hGt' c6.1
    have c4 := chainStepC hF hFt c5.1
    have c4a := chainStepC hE hEt c4.1
    have c3 := chainStepC hD hDt c4a.1
    have c2 := chainStepC hC hCt' c3.1
    refine ⟨d * 4 + 3 + 1 + (1 + 1 + (5 + 1 + (5 + 1 +
      ((11 * ((bitCells ws).reverse.length + 1) + 1) + 1 +
        (5 + 1 + 6))))), G₂.drop 5, hG₂.drop 5, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hd0 : d = ws.length + 1 := by
        rw [hd]
        simp
      have hlen : (bitCells ws).reverse.length = ws.length := by
        simp [bitCells]
      rw [hd0, hlen]
      omega

    · have hfin := c2.2
      rw [c3.2] at hfin
      rw [c4a.2] at hfin
      rw [c4.2] at hfin
      rw [c5.2] at hfin

theorems.natural_language_statement:
The in-place dilation machine and the proved core of its round.

`dilation i` converts a tape holding raw input bits into the parked two-track region hosting that input beside an empty track — the initialization `eliminate_last_scratch_tape` needs, forced by the three-symbol alphabet. Structure: a one-step read dispatches empty input to `initRegion` through the new `TypedMachine.either` combinator (branches of *different state types* run on their sum — the missing dispatch primitive); otherwise a pre-pass shifts the whole input five right, and a `loopState` round harvests one cell, shifts the remainder five right, and writes one six-cell block over the five separators plus the harvested cell. A round that reads blank writes the all-blank flag-clear `exitBlock` — `PadEq` absorbs it — and the loop stops on the symbol captured in the terminal state, read by the generic `stateRead` peel.

**`dilCont_spec_bit`, proved in both branches, is the phase's centerpiece**: the post-read chain — scan right, step back, probe, shift, five left, write — runs in at most $15|{\rm rest}| + 40$ steps and lands exactly on the next round's invariant, the head at the new separator start over blocks-so-far extended by the new block. The empty-remainder branch runs the same chain with the shifter halting at once, which is what makes the loop's last round uniform with the others.

One elaboration point worth recording: `writeRun`'s state type carries the cell list's length, so a family over the captured symbol is only type-uniform because `Block.toCells` is a literal six-cell list — its length reduces definitionally even on stuck arguments. The `dilWrite` wrapper pins that down once.
theorems.definition:
import Definitions.Def_sgl_machine_either

/-!
# In-place input dilation

Module G2 of DESIGN_finish_mission: convert a tape holding raw input bits into
the parked two-track region hosting (that input, the empty scratch tape).

Layout invariant before round `i` (head at the separator start, position
`6(i−1)` relative to the block region's origin): blocks written so far to the
left, five blank separators under and right of the head, the next input cell
five right, the compact remainder after it, blanks beyond.  One round harvests
the cell, shifts the remainder five right (vacating the next separators),
and writes the six-cell block over the old separators plus the harvested cell.

A round that reads blank instead of an input bit writes the all-blank
`exitBlock` (flags clear — `PadEq` absorbs it) and the loop stops on the
captured symbol.  The empty input never enters the loop: a top-level read
dispatches it to `initRegion` through `TypedMachine.either`.
-/

namespace SipserGacsLautemann

variable {tapes : Nat}

/-- The block hosting one input cell on track A, empty track B. -/
def inputBlock (b : Bool) (first : Bool) : Block :=
  ⟨TapeSymbol.bit b, first, TapeSymbol.blank, first⟩

/-- The block a blank read writes: both tracks blank, flags clear. -/
def exitBlock : Block :=
  ⟨TapeSymbol.blank, false, TapeSymbol.blank, false⟩

/-- The block a round writes, from the captured symbol. -/
def blockFor (rec : Option TapeSymbol) (first : Bool) : Block :=
  match rec with
  | some (TapeSymbol.bit b) => inputBlock b first
  | _ => ⟨TapeSymbol.blank, first, TapeSymbol.blank, first⟩

/-- The region the dilation builds for a *non-empty* input. -/
def dilBlocks : List Bool → List Block
  | [] => [exitBlock]
  | x :: xs => inputBlock x true ::
      (xs.map fun b => inputBlock b false) ++ [exitBlock]

/-- The region for arbitrary input (empty input gets the merge-init block). -/
def encodeInputBlocks (xs : List Bool) : List Block :=
  match xs with
  | [] => [initBlock]
  | _ => dilBlocks xs

/-- Input bits as tape symbols. -/
def bitCells (xs : List Bool) : List TapeSymbol :=
  xs.map fun b => TapeSymbol.bit b

/-- The round invariant: head at the separator start. -/
def dilTape (done : List Block) (rest : List Bool) (G : List TapeSymbol) :
    Tape :=
  cellsTape ((encodeBlocks done).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank])
    (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ bitCells rest ++ G)

/-! ## The machines -/

/-- Read the head symbol, erase it, stay. -/
def eraseRead (i : Fin tapes) :=
  TypedMachine.readAct (fun syms =>
    (syms i,
      fun j => (if j = i then TapeSymbol.blank else syms j, HeadMove.stay)))

/-- The block write, at its reduced state type. -/
def dilWrite (i : Fin tapes) (rec : Option TapeSymbol) (first : Bool) :
    TypedMachine tapes (Fin 7) :=
  writeRun i (Block.toCells (blockFor rec first))

/-- The post-read chain of one round. -/
def dilCont (i : Fin tapes) (rec : Option TapeSymbol) (first : Bool) :=
  (scanToBlank i HeadMove.right).andThen fun _ =>
    (moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.left).andThen fun _ =>
      (moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.right).andThen fun _ =>
        (moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).andThen fun _ =>
          (shiftSeg5 i).andThen fun _ =>
            (moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).andThen fun _ =>
              dilWrite i rec first

/-- One dilation round. -/
def dilBody (i : Fin tapes) (first : Bool) :=
  (moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.right).andThen fun _ =>
    (eraseRead i).andThenState (fun s => s.isSome) fun rec =>
      dilCont i rec first

/-- Recover the captured symbol from a terminal body state (generic in the
layers around the `andThenState` junction). -/
def stateRead {S₁ S₂ : Type}
    (s : S₁ ⊕ Bool × (Option TapeSymbol ⊕ Option TapeSymbol × S₂)) :
    Option TapeSymbol :=
  match s with
  | .inr (_, .inr (rec, _)) => rec
  | _ => none

@[simp] theorem stateRead_inr {S₁ S₂ : Type} (b : Bool)
    (rec : Option TapeSymbol) (s : S₂) :
    stateRead (S₁ := S₁) (Sum.inr (b, Sum.inr (rec, s))) = rec := rfl

/-- Was the captured symbol an input bit? -/
def isBitO : Option TapeSymbol → Bool
  | some (TapeSymbol.bit _) => true
  | _ => false

/-- The dilation loop: run rounds while the read is an input bit. -/
def dilLoop (i : Fin tapes) :=
  TypedMachine.loopState (fun first => dilBody i first)
    (fun _ _ => false)
    (fun _ b => !(isBitO (stateRead b)))
    (fun _ _ => false)
    true

/-- The pre-pass: materialise home, shift the whole input right by five. -/
def prePass (i : Fin tapes) :=
  (moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.left).andThen fun _ =>
    (moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right).andThen fun _ =>
      (scanToBlank i HeadMove.right).andThen fun _ =>
        (moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.left).andThen fun _ =>
          (moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.right).andThen fun _ =>
            (moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).andThen fun _ =>
              (shiftSeg5 i).andThen fun _ =>
                moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.right

/-- The whole non-empty path: pre-pass, loop, park. -/
def dilMain (i : Fin tapes) :=
  (prePass i).andThen fun _ =>
    (dilLoop i).andThen fun _ =>
      scanToBlank i HeadMove.left

/-- **The dilation machine**: dispatch on the first cell. -/
def dilation (i : Fin tapes) :=
  (TypedMachine.readAct (fun syms =>
      (syms i, fun j => (syms j, HeadMove.stay)))).andThenState
    (fun s => s.isSome) fun rec =>
      (dilMain i).either (initRegion i) (isBitO rec)


/-! ## Support lemmas -/

/-- The shifter on a blank head: one step, halt, tape unchanged. -/
theorem shiftSeg5_halt_spec (i : Fin tapes) (T : Fin tapes → Tape)
    (hb : (T i).head = TapeSymbol.blank) :
    HaltsExactly (shiftSeg5 i) ((shiftSeg5 i).startCfg T) 1 false ∧
    (((shiftSeg5 i).step^[1]) ((shiftSeg5 i).startCfg T)).tape = T := by
  have hstep : ((shiftSeg5 i).step^[1]) ((shiftSeg5 i).startCfg T) =
      ⟨(⟨11, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T⟩ := by
    rw [Function.iterate_one]
    exact shiftSeg5_step_halt i T hb
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [hstep]; rfl
  · intro j hj
    have : j = 0 := by omega
    subst this
    rfl
  · rw [hstep]

/-- The erase-read's tape action. -/
theorem applyAction_erase (i : Fin tapes) (T : Fin tapes → Tape) :
    applyAction T (fun syms j =>
        (if j = i then TapeSymbol.blank else syms j, HeadMove.stay)) =
      Function.update T i (Tape.write (T i) TapeSymbol.blank) := by
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst hj
    simp [applyAction, Tape.move]
  · simp [applyAction, hj, Tape.write_head_self, Tape.move]

/-- A tape parked over an all-blank right context reads blank. -/
theorem cellsTape_head_allBlank (L G : List TapeSymbol) (hG : AllBlank G) :
    (cellsTape L G).head = TapeSymbol.blank := by
  cases G with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons g G' => exact hG g (by simp)

/-- Five retreats over the separator cells. -/
theorem retreat5 (L R : List TapeSymbol) (r : TapeSymbol) :
    ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[5])
        (cellsTape (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ L) (r :: R)) =
      cellsTape L (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ r :: R) := by
  have h := cellsTape_retreat (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank) L R r
  simpa using h

@[simp] theorem bitCells_ne_blank (xs : List Bool) :
    ∀ c ∈ bitCells xs, c ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
  intro c hc
  simp only [bitCells, List.mem_map] at hc
  obtain ⟨b, -, rfl⟩ := hc
  simp

@[simp] theorem bitCells_nil : bitCells [] = [] := rfl

@[simp] theorem bitCells_cons (x : Bool) (xs : List Bool) :
    bitCells (x :: xs) = TapeSymbol.bit x :: bitCells xs := rfl

theorem bitCells_append (xs ys : List Bool) :
    bitCells (xs ++ ys) = bitCells xs ++ bitCells ys := by
  simp [bitCells]

theorem encodeBlocks_snoc (bs : List Block) (b : Block) :
    encodeBlocks (bs ++ [b]) = encodeBlocks bs ++ Block.toCells b := by
  rw [encodeBlocks_append]
  simp


/-! ## Left-move over an all-blank right context -/

theorem moveDir_left_allBlank (c : TapeSymbol) (L R : List TapeSymbol)
    (hR : AllBlank R) :
    ∃ R₂, AllBlank R₂ ∧
      moveDir HeadMove.left (cellsTape (c :: L) R) = cellsTape L (c :: R₂) := by
  cases R with
  | nil =>
      exact ⟨[TapeSymbol.blank], AllBlank.single, cellsTape_moveLeft_nil L c⟩
  | cons r R' =>
      exact ⟨r :: R', hR, cellsTape_moveLeft L c r R'⟩

set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
/-- **The post-read chain on an input bit**: shift the remainder five right,
write the block, land at the next separator start over the round invariant. -/
theorem dilCont_spec_bit (i : Fin tapes) (first x : Bool)
    (done : List Block) (rest : List Bool) (G : List TapeSymbol)
    (T2 : Fin tapes → Tape) (hG : AllBlank G)
    (hT2 : T2 i = cellsTape
      (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
        ((encodeBlocks done).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]))
      (TapeSymbol.blank :: bitCells rest ++ G)) :
    ∃ (cost : Nat) (G' : List TapeSymbol), AllBlank G' ∧
      cost ≤ 15 * rest.length + 40 ∧
      HaltsExactly (dilCont i (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first)
        ((dilCont i (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first).startCfg T2) cost true ∧
      (((dilCont i (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first).step^[cost])
        ((dilCont i (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first).startCfg T2)).tape =
        Function.update T2 i (cellsTape
          ((encodeBlocks (done ++ [inputBlock x first])).reverse ++
            [TapeSymbol.blank])
          (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ bitCells rest ++ G')) := by
  classical
  set L0 := (encodeBlocks done).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] with hL0
  set L2 := List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ L0 with hL2
  set d := rest.length with hd
  -- ===== stage C: scan right over the remainder =====
  have hadv : ∀ k, k ≤ d →
      ((moveDir HeadMove.right)^[k + 1]) (T2 i) =
        cellsTape ((TapeSymbol.blank :: bitCells (rest.take k)).reverse ++ L2)
          (bitCells (rest.drop k) ++ G) := by
    intro k hk
    have hsplit : TapeSymbol.blank :: bitCells rest ++ G =
        (TapeSymbol.blank :: bitCells (rest.take k)) ++
          (bitCells (rest.drop k) ++ G) := by
      rw [show TapeSymbol.blank :: bitCells (rest.take k) ++
          (bitCells (rest.drop k) ++ G) =
        TapeSymbol.blank :: (bitCells (rest.take k) ++ bitCells (rest.drop k))
          ++ G by simp]
      rw [← bitCells_append, List.take_append_drop]
    have hlen : (TapeSymbol.blank :: bitCells (rest.take k)).length = k + 1 := by
      simp [bitCells, List.length_take]
      omega
    rw [hT2, hsplit, ← hlen, cellsTape_advance]
  have hlt : ∀ k, k < d →
      (((moveDir HeadMove.right)^[k + 1]) (T2 i)).head ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := by
    intro k hk
    rw [hadv k (by omega)]
    obtain ⟨y, ys, hdrop⟩ : ∃ y ys, rest.drop k = y :: ys := by
      cases hdk : rest.drop k with
      | nil =>
          exfalso
          have := congrArg List.length hdk
          simp [List.length_drop] at this
          omega
      | cons y ys => exact ⟨y, ys, rfl⟩
    rw [hdrop]
    simp [cellsTape]
  have heq : (((moveDir HeadMove.right)^[d + 1]) (T2 i)).head =
      TapeSymbol.blank := by
    rw [hadv d le_rfl]
    rw [show rest.drop d = [] by rw [hd]; exact List.drop_length]
    exact cellsTape_head_allBlank _ G hG
  have hC := scanToBlank_spec_of i HeadMove.right T2 d hlt heq
  have hCt := scanToBlank_tape_of i HeadMove.right T2 d hlt heq
  set T3 := Function.update T2 i
    (cellsTape ((bitCells rest).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] ++ L2) G)
    with hT3
  have hCt' : (((scanToBlank i HeadMove.right).step^[d * 4 + 3])
      ((scanToBlank i HeadMove.right).startCfg T2)).tape = T3 := by
    rw [hCt, hT3]
    show scanTapesDir T2 i HeadMove.right (d + 1) = _
    rw [scanTapesDir]
    congr 1
    rw [hadv d le_rfl]
    rw [show rest.drop d = [] by rw [hd]; exact List.drop_length,
      show rest.take d = rest by rw [hd]; exact List.take_length]
    simp
  have hT3i : T3 i =
      cellsTape ((bitCells rest).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] ++ L2) G := by
    rw [hT3]; simp
  -- ===== stages D–I, by the shape of the remainder =====
  rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat rest with hrest | ⟨ws, w, hrest⟩
  case inl =>
    subst hrest
    -- ----- D: one left -----
    obtain ⟨G₂, hG₂, hmv⟩ := moveDir_left_allBlank TapeSymbol.blank L2 G hG
    have hD := moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.left (by omega) T3
    set T4 := Function.update T3 i (cellsTape L2 (TapeSymbol.blank :: G₂))
      with hT4
    have hDt : (((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.left).step^[1])
        ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.left).startCfg T3)).tape = T4 := by
      rw [moveUpTo_tape i 1 HeadMove.left (by omega) T3, hT4]
      congr 1
      rw [Function.iterate_one, hT3i]
      show moveDir HeadMove.left
        (cellsTape (TapeSymbol.blank :: L2) G) = _
      rw [hmv]
    have hT4i : T4 i = cellsTape L2 (TapeSymbol.blank :: G₂) := by
      rw [hT4]; simp
    -- ----- E,F: the probe -----
    have hE := moveUpTo_spec i 5 HeadMove.right (by omega) T4
    set T5 := Function.update T4 i
      ((moveDir HeadMove.right)^[5] (T4 i)) with hT5
    have hEt : (((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.right).step^[5])
        ((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.right).startCfg T4)).tape = T5 := by
      rw [moveUpTo_tape i 5 HeadMove.right (by omega) T4, hT5]
    have hF := moveUpTo_spec i 5 HeadMove.left (by omega) T5
    set T6 := Function.update T5 i
      (cellsTape L2 (TapeSymbol.blank ::
        List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5)) with hT6
    have hFt : (((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).step^[5])
        ((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).startCfg T5)).tape = T6 := by
      rw [moveUpTo_tape i 5 HeadMove.left (by omega) T5, hT6, hT5]
      simp only [Function.update_idem, Function.update_self]
      congr 1
      rw [hT4i, hL2]
      show ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[5])
        (((moveDir HeadMove.right)^[5]) (cellsTape
          (TapeSymbol.blank :: (List.replicate 4 TapeSymbol.blank ++ L0))
          (TapeSymbol.blank :: G₂))) = _
      rw [moveDir_probe5 TapeSymbol.blank TapeSymbol.blank _ G₂ hG₂]
      rfl
    have hT6i : T6 i = cellsTape L2 (TapeSymbol.blank ::
        List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5) := by
      rw [hT6]; simp
    -- ----- G: the shifter halts at once -----
    obtain ⟨hGh, hGt⟩ := shiftSeg5_halt_spec i T6 (by rw [hT6i]; rfl)
    -- ----- H: five left -----
    have hH := moveUpTo_spec i 5 HeadMove.left (by omega) T6
    set T7 := Function.update T6 i
      (cellsTape L0 (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ TapeSymbol.blank ::
        List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5)) with hT7
    have hHt : (((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).step^[5])
        ((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).startCfg T6)).tape = T7 := by
      rw [moveUpTo_tape i 5 HeadMove.left (by omega) T6, hT7]
      congr 1
      rw [hT6i, hL2]
      exact retreat5 L0 _ TapeSymbol.blank
    have hT7i : T7 i = cellsTape L0
        (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ TapeSymbol.blank ::
          List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5) := by
      rw [hT7]; simp
    -- ----- I: write the block -----
    have hI := writeRun_spec i
      (Block.toCells (blockFor (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first)) T7 _ _ hT7i
    have hIt := writeRun_tape i
      (Block.toCells (blockFor (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first)) T7 _ _ hT7i
    -- ----- assemble -----
    have c6 := chainStepC hH hHt hI
    have c5 := chainStepC hGh hGt c6.1
    have c4 := chainStepC hF hFt c5.1
    have c4a := chainStepC hE hEt c4.1
    have c3 := chainStepC hD hDt c4a.1
    have c2 := chainStepC hC hCt' c3.1
    refine ⟨d * 4 + 3 + 1 + (1 + 1 + (5 + 1 + (5 + 1 + (1 + 1 +
      (5 + 1 + 6))))), G₂.drop 5, hG₂.drop 5, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hd0 : d = 0 := by rw [hd]; rfl
      omega
    · exact c2.1
    · have hfin := c2.2
      rw [c3.2] at hfin
      rw [c4a.2] at hfin
      rw [c4.2] at hfin
      rw [c5.2] at hfin
      rw [c6.2] at hfin
      have hfin' : ((dilCont i (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first).step^[
          d * 4 + 3 + 1 + (1 + 1 + (5 + 1 + (5 + 1 + (1 + 1 +
            (5 + 1 + 6)))))])
          ((dilCont i (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first).startCfg T2) = _ :=
        hfin
      rw [hfin']
      show (((writeRun i (Block.toCells (blockFor (some (TapeSymbol.bit x))
          first))).step^[(Block.toCells (blockFor (some (TapeSymbol.bit x))
          first)).length]) ((writeRun i (Block.toCells (blockFor
          (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first))).startCfg T7)).tape = _
      rw [hIt]
      rw [hT7, hT6, hT5, hT4, hT3]
      simp only [Function.update_idem]
      congr 1
      rw [show (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ TapeSymbol.blank ::
          List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5).drop
            (Block.toCells (blockFor (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first)).length =
          List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5 by
        rw [Block.toCells_length]
        rfl]
      rw [hL0, show blockFor (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first =
        inputBlock x first from rfl]
      rw [show (Block.toCells (inputBlock x first)).reverse ++
          ((encodeBlocks done).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) =
        (encodeBlocks (done ++ [inputBlock x first])).reverse ++
          [TapeSymbol.blank] by
        rw [encodeBlocks_snoc, List.reverse_append]
        simp]
      simp
  case inr =>
    rw [List.concat_eq_append] at hrest
    subst hrest
    have hbc : (bitCells (ws ++ [w])).reverse =
        TapeSymbol.bit w :: (bitCells ws).reverse := by
      rw [bitCells_append]
      simp
    -- ----- D: one left, onto the remainder's last cell -----
    obtain ⟨G₂, hG₂, hmv⟩ := moveDir_left_allBlank (TapeSymbol.bit w)
      ((bitCells ws).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] ++ L2) G hG
    have hD := moveUpTo_spec i 1 HeadMove.left (by omega) T3
    set T4 := Function.update T3 i
      (cellsTape ((bitCells ws).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] ++ L2)
        (TapeSymbol.bit w :: G₂)) with hT4
    have hDt : (((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.left).step^[1])
        ((moveUpTo i 1 HeadMove.left).startCfg T3)).tape = T4 := by
      rw [moveUpTo_tape i 1 HeadMove.left (by omega) T3, hT4]
      congr 1
      rw [Function.iterate_one, hT3i, hbc]
      show moveDir HeadMove.left (cellsTape (TapeSymbol.bit w ::
        ((bitCells ws).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] ++ L2)) G) = _
      rw [hmv]
    have hT4i : T4 i = cellsTape
        ((bitCells ws).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] ++ L2)
        (TapeSymbol.bit w :: G₂) := by
      rw [hT4]; simp
    -- ----- E,F: the probe -----
    obtain ⟨cc, Lr, hcL⟩ : ∃ cc Lr,
        (bitCells ws).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] ++ L2 = cc :: Lr := by
      cases hws : (bitCells ws).reverse with
      | nil => exact ⟨TapeSymbol.blank, L2, by simp⟩
      | cons a t => exact ⟨a, t ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] ++ L2, by simp⟩
    have hE := moveUpTo_spec i 5 HeadMove.right (by omega) T4
    set T5 := Function.update T4 i
      ((moveDir HeadMove.right)^[5] (T4 i)) with hT5
    have hEt : (((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.right).step^[5])
        ((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.right).startCfg T4)).tape = T5 := by
      rw [moveUpTo_tape i 5 HeadMove.right (by omega) T4, hT5]
    have hF := moveUpTo_spec i 5 HeadMove.left (by omega) T5
    set T6 := Function.update T5 i
      (cellsTape ((bitCells ws).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] ++ L2)
        (TapeSymbol.bit w ::
          List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5)) with hT6
    have hFt : (((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).step^[5])
        ((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).startCfg T5)).tape = T6 := by
      rw [moveUpTo_tape i 5 HeadMove.left (by omega) T5, hT6, hT5]
      simp only [Function.update_idem, Function.update_self]
      congr 1
      rw [hT4i, hcL]
      exact moveDir_probe5 cc (TapeSymbol.bit w) Lr G₂ hG₂
    have hT6i : T6 i = cellsTape
        ((bitCells ws).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank] ++ L2)
        (TapeSymbol.bit w ::
          List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5) := by
      rw [hT6]; simp
    -- ----- G: the shift -----
    have hT6i' : T6 i = cellsTape
        ((bitCells ws).reverse ++ TapeSymbol.blank :: L2)
        (TapeSymbol.bit w ::
          List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G₂.drop 5) := by
      rw [hT6i]
      congr 1
      simp
    obtain ⟨hGh, hGt⟩ := shiftSeg5_spec i (bitCells ws).reverse
      (TapeSymbol.bit w) L2 (G₂.drop 5) T6 (by simp)
      (fun c hc => bitCells_ne_blank ws c (List.mem_reverse.mp hc)) hT6i'
    -- ----- H: five left -----
    set T7g := Function.update T6 i
      (cellsTape L2 (TapeSymbol.blank ::
        List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
          ((bitCells ws).reverse.reverse ++ TapeSymbol.bit w ::
            G₂.drop 5))) with hT7g
    have hGt' : (((shiftSeg5 i).step^[11 * ((bitCells ws).reverse.length + 1)
        + 1]) ((shiftSeg5 i).startCfg T6)).tape = T7g := by
      rw [hGt, hT7g]
    have hT7gi : T7g i = cellsTape L2 (TapeSymbol.blank ::
        List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
          (bitCells (ws ++ [w]) ++ G₂.drop 5)) := by
      rw [hT7g]
      simp only [Function.update_self]
      congr 2
      rw [List.reverse_reverse, bitCells_append]
      simp
    have hH := moveUpTo_spec i 5 HeadMove.left (by omega) T7g
    set T8 := Function.update T7g i
      (cellsTape L0 (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ TapeSymbol.blank ::
        List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
          (bitCells (ws ++ [w]) ++ G₂.drop 5))) with hT8
    have hHt : (((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).step^[5])
        ((moveUpTo i 5 HeadMove.left).startCfg T7g)).tape = T8 := by
      rw [moveUpTo_tape i 5 HeadMove.left (by omega) T7g, hT8]
      congr 1
      rw [hT7gi, hL2]
      exact retreat5 L0 _ TapeSymbol.blank
    have hT8i : T8 i = cellsTape L0
        (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ TapeSymbol.blank ::
          List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
            (bitCells (ws ++ [w]) ++ G₂.drop 5)) := by
      rw [hT8]; simp
    -- ----- I: write the block -----
    have hI := writeRun_spec i
      (Block.toCells (blockFor (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first)) T8 _ _ hT8i
    have hIt := writeRun_tape i
      (Block.toCells (blockFor (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first)) T8 _ _ hT8i
    -- ----- assemble -----
    have c6 := chainStepC hH hHt hI
    have c5 := chainStepC hGh hGt' c6.1
    have c4 := chainStepC hF hFt c5.1
    have c4a := chainStepC hE hEt c4.1
    have c3 := chainStepC hD hDt c4a.1
    have c2 := chainStepC hC hCt' c3.1
    refine ⟨d * 4 + 3 + 1 + (1 + 1 + (5 + 1 + (5 + 1 +
      ((11 * ((bitCells ws).reverse.length + 1) + 1) + 1 +
        (5 + 1 + 6))))), G₂.drop 5, hG₂.drop 5, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hd0 : d = ws.length + 1 := by
        rw [hd]
        simp
      have hlen : (bitCells ws).reverse.length = ws.length := by
        simp [bitCells]
      rw [hd0, hlen]
      omega
    · exact c2.1
    · have hfin := c2.2
      rw [c3.2] at hfin
      rw [c4a.2] at hfin
      rw [c4.2] at hfin
      rw [c5.2] at hfin
      rw [c6.2] at hfin
      have hfin' : ((dilCont i (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first).step^[
          d * 4 + 3 + 1 + (1 + 1 + (5 + 1 + (5 + 1 +
            ((11 * ((bitCells ws).reverse.length + 1) + 1) + 1 +
              (5 + 1 + 6)))))])
          ((dilCont i (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first).startCfg T2) = _ :=
        hfin
      rw [hfin']
      show (((writeRun i (Block.toCells (blockFor (some (TapeSymbol.bit x))
          first))).step^[(Block.toCells (blockFor (some (TapeSymbol.bit x))
          first)).length]) ((writeRun i (Block.toCells (blockFor
          (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first))).startCfg T8)).tape = _
      rw [hIt]
      rw [hT8, hT7g, hT6, hT5, hT4, hT3]
      simp only [Function.update_idem]
      congr 1
      rw [show (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ TapeSymbol.blank ::
          List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
            (bitCells (ws ++ [w]) ++ G₂.drop 5)).drop
            (Block.toCells (blockFor (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first)).length =
          List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
            (bitCells (ws ++ [w]) ++ G₂.drop 5) by
        rw [Block.toCells_length]
        rfl]
      rw [hL0, show blockFor (some (TapeSymbol.bit x)) first =
        inputBlock x first from rfl]
      rw [show (Block.toCells (inputBlock x first)).reverse ++
          ((encodeBlocks done).reverse ++ [TapeSymbol.blank]) =
        (encodeBlocks (done ++ [inputBlock x first])).reverse ++
          [TapeSymbol.blank] by
        rw [encodeBlocks_snoc, List.reverse_append]

theorems.natural_language_statement:
The segment shifter: the primitive for in-place input dilation under a three-symbol alphabet.

`shiftSeg5 i` expects the head on the rightmost cell of a non-blank segment. Each eleven-step cycle picks the cell up (erasing it), carries it five cells right, drops it, and retreats to the cell left of the vacated one; a pickup that reads blank halts the machine. Right-to-left order is what makes the target always blank — cells to the right have already moved. `shiftSeg5_spec` runs it over a whole segment: cost $11(|{\rm seg}|)+1$, every cell translated five right, head parked on the boundary blank, with the vacated cells left explicitly blank.

**The probe.** The zipper representation records only cells actually visited, so a segment's right context may be a *materialised-blank history* of any length — the visited-blank problem, again. `moveDir_probe5` resolves it without touching the shift machine: walking five right and five back changes no content but forces at least five cells beyond the head to exist explicitly, after which every cycle can use the explicit six-cell window form. One lemma, pure tape algebra, no machine case analysis.

**A design simplification found while building this.** The dilation needs no separate shift-by-one pre-pass: running this same shifter once over the whole input creates a *five*-blank separator region, and the block-writing loop maintains five-blank separators invariantly — each iteration's six-cell block overwrites the five separators plus the harvested cell, and the shift vacates the next five. One primitive machine serves the entire dilation.

import Definitions.Def_sgl_merge_solution

/-!
# Shifting a segment right by five

Module G1 of DESIGN_finish_mission: the primitive for in-place input dilation.

`shiftSeg5 i` expects the head on the rightmost cell of a non-blank segment
whose right context is blank far enough out.  Each eleven-step cycle picks the
cell up (erasing it), carries it five cells right, drops it, and returns to
the cell to the left of the vacated one; when the pickup reads blank the
machine halts.  Right-to-left order is what makes the target cell always
blank: cells to the right have already moved.
-/

namespace SipserGacsLautemann

variable {tapes : Nat}

/-- Carry one cell five to the right, repeatedly, right to left. -/
def shiftSeg5 (i : Fin tapes) : TypedMachine tapes (Fin 12 × TapeSymbol) where
  start := (⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank)
  transition := fun s symbols =>
    if _h0 : s.1.val = 0 then
      if symbols i = TapeSymbol.blank then
        ((⟨11, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank),
          fun j => (symbols j, HeadMove.stay))
      else
        ((⟨1, by omega⟩, symbols i),
          fun j =>
            (if j = i then TapeSymbol.blank else symbols j,
              if j = i then HeadMove.right else HeadMove.stay))
    else if _h4 : s.1.val ≤ 4 then
      ((⟨s.1.val + 1, by omega⟩, s.2),
        fun j => (symbols j, if j = i then HeadMove.right else HeadMove.stay))
    else if _h5 : s.1.val = 5 then
      ((⟨6, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank),
        fun j =>
          (if j = i then s.2 else symbols j,
            if j = i then HeadMove.left else HeadMove.stay))
    else if _h9 : s.1.val ≤ 9 then
      ((⟨s.1.val + 1, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank),
        fun j => (symbols j, if j = i then HeadMove.left else HeadMove.stay))
    else if _h10 : s.1.val = 10 then
      ((⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank),
        fun j => (symbols j, if j = i then HeadMove.left else HeadMove.stay))
    else (s, fun j => (symbols j, HeadMove.stay))
  result := fun s => if s.1.val = 11 then some false else none

/-! ## Step equations -/

theorem shiftSeg5_step_halt (i : Fin tapes) (t : Fin tapes → Tape)
    (hb : (t i).head = TapeSymbol.blank) :
    (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), t⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨11, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), t⟩ := by
  have hres : (shiftSeg5 i).result (⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank) = none := by
    simp [shiftSeg5]
  simp only [TypedMachine.step, hres]
  simp only [shiftSeg5, hb]
  norm_num
  funext j
  simp [Tape.write_head_self, Tape.move]

theorem shiftSeg5_step_pick (i : Fin tapes) (t : Fin tapes → Tape)
    (hb : (t i).head ≠ TapeSymbol.blank) :
    (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), t⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨1, by omega⟩, (t i).head),
        Function.update t i
          (moveDir HeadMove.right (Tape.write (t i) TapeSymbol.blank))⟩ := by
  have hres : (shiftSeg5 i).result (⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank) = none := by
    simp [shiftSeg5]
  simp only [TypedMachine.step, hres]
  simp only [shiftSeg5]
  norm_num [hb]
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst hj
    simp [moveDir]
  · simp [hj, Function.update_of_ne hj, Tape.write_head_self, Tape.move]

theorem shiftSeg5_step_right (i : Fin tapes) (t : Fin tapes → Tape)
    (k : Nat) (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk4 : k ≤ 4) (x : TapeSymbol) :
    (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨k, by omega⟩, x), t⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨k + 1, by omega⟩, x),
        Function.update t i (moveDir HeadMove.right (t i))⟩ := by
  have hres : (shiftSeg5 i).result (⟨k, by omega⟩, x) = none := by
    simp only [shiftSeg5]
    exact if_neg (by omega)
  simp only [TypedMachine.step, hres]
  simp only [shiftSeg5]
  rw [dif_neg (show ¬ (k = 0) by omega)]
  rw [dif_pos (show k ≤ 4 from hk4)]
  congr 1
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst hj
    simp [moveDir, Tape.write_head_self]
  · simp [hj, Function.update_of_ne hj, Tape.write_head_self, Tape.move]

theorem shiftSeg5_step_drop (i : Fin tapes) (t : Fin tapes → Tape)
    (x : TapeSymbol) :
    (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨5, by omega⟩, x), t⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨6, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank),
        Function.update t i (moveDir HeadMove.left (Tape.write (t i) x))⟩ := by
  have hres : (shiftSeg5 i).result (⟨5, by omega⟩, x) = none := by

  · subst hj

  · simp [hj, Function.update_of_ne hj, Tape.write_head_self, Tape.move]

theorem shiftSeg5_step_left (i : Fin tapes) (t : Fin tapes → Tape)
    (k : Nat) (hk6 : 6 ≤ k) (hk9 : k ≤ 9) (x : TapeSymbol) :

theorem shiftSeg5_step_home (i : Fin tapes) (t : Fin tapes → Tape)

    (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨10, by omega⟩, x), t⟩ =

/-! ## Blank-context move helpers -/

theorem moveDir_right_blank (L R : List TapeSymbol) (hR : AllBlank R) :
    moveDir HeadMove.right (cellsTape L R) =
      cellsTape (TapeSymbol.blank :: L) R.tail := by
  cases R with
  | nil => exact cellsTape_moveRight_nil L
  | cons r R' =>
      have hr : r = TapeSymbol.blank := hR r (by simp)
      rw [show cellsTape L (r :: R') = cellsTape L (TapeSymbol.blank :: R') by
        rw [hr]]
      exact cellsTape_moveRight L TapeSymbol.blank R'

theorem write_cellsTape (L R : List TapeSymbol) (y : TapeSymbol) :
    Tape.write (cellsTape L R) y = cellsTape L (y :: R.tail) := by
  cases R <;> rfl

/-! ## One eleven-step cycle, explicit-cons right context -/

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
/-- One cycle over a six-cell window: the head cell moves five right, the
window's other five cells are preserved, the head retreats one left of the
vacated cell. -/
theorem shiftSeg5_cycle (i : Fin tapes) (T : Fin tapes → Tape)
    (c y r₁ r₂ r₃ r₄ r₅ : TapeSymbol) (L Q : List TapeSymbol)
    (hy : y ≠ TapeSymbol.blank)
    (hTi : T i = cellsTape (c :: L) (y :: r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: r₅ :: Q)) :
    (((shiftSeg5 i).step^[11]) ⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T⟩ :
        TypedConfiguration tapes (Fin 12 × TapeSymbol)) =
      ⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank),
        Function.update T i
          (cellsTape L (c :: TapeSymbol.blank :: r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ ::
            y :: Q))⟩ ∧
    ∀ j, j < 11 →
      ((((shiftSeg5 i).step^[j]) ⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T⟩ :
        TypedConfiguration tapes (Fin 12 × TapeSymbol))).state.1.val ≠ 11 := by
  have hy' : (T i).head = y := by rw [hTi]; rfl
  have e0 := shiftSeg5_step_pick i T (by rw [hy']; exact hy)
  rw [hy'] at e0
  set T1 := Function.update T i
    (cellsTape (TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: r₅ :: Q)) with hT1
  have e0' : (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨1, by omega⟩, y), T1⟩ := by
    rw [e0, hT1, hTi, write_cellsTape]
    rw [show (y :: r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: r₅ :: Q).tail =
      r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: r₅ :: Q from rfl]
    rw [cellsTape_moveRight]
  have hT1i : T1 i = cellsTape (TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: r₅ :: Q) := by rw [hT1]; simp
  -- four carries right
  have e1 := shiftSeg5_step_right i T1 1 (by omega) (by omega) y
  set T2 := Function.update T1 i
    (cellsTape (r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L) (r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: r₅ :: Q))
    with hT2
  have e1' : (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨1, by omega⟩, y), T1⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨2, by omega⟩, y), T2⟩ := by
    rw [e1, hT2, hT1i, cellsTape_moveRight]
  have hT2i : T2 i = cellsTape (r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: r₅ :: Q) := by rw [hT2]; simp
  have e2 := shiftSeg5_step_right i T2 2 (by omega) (by omega) y
  set T3 := Function.update T2 i
    (cellsTape (r₂ :: r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L) (r₃ :: r₄ :: r₅ :: Q))
    with hT3
  have e2' : (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨2, by omega⟩, y), T2⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨3, by omega⟩, y), T3⟩ := by
    rw [e2, hT3, hT2i, cellsTape_moveRight]
  have hT3i : T3 i = cellsTape (r₂ :: r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₃ :: r₄ :: r₅ :: Q) := by rw [hT3]; simp
  have e3 := shiftSeg5_step_right i T3 3 (by omega) (by omega) y
  set T4 := Function.update T3 i
    (cellsTape (r₃ :: r₂ :: r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₄ :: r₅ :: Q)) with hT4
  have e3' : (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨3, by omega⟩, y), T3⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨4, by omega⟩, y), T4⟩ := by
    rw [e3, hT4, hT3i, cellsTape_moveRight]
  have hT4i : T4 i = cellsTape (r₃ :: r₂ :: r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₄ :: r₅ :: Q) := by rw [hT4]; simp
  have e4 := shiftSeg5_step_right i T4 4 (by omega) (by omega) y
  set T5 := Function.update T4 i
    (cellsTape (r₄ :: r₃ :: r₂ :: r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₅ :: Q)) with hT5
  have e4' : (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨4, by omega⟩, y), T4⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨5, by omega⟩, y), T5⟩ := by
    rw [e4, hT5, hT4i, cellsTape_moveRight]
  have hT5i : T5 i = cellsTape
      (r₄ :: r₃ :: r₂ :: r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L) (r₅ :: Q) := by
    rw [hT5]; simp
  -- drop
  have e5 := shiftSeg5_step_drop i T5 y
  set T6 := Function.update T5 i
    (cellsTape (r₃ :: r₂ :: r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₄ :: y :: Q)) with hT6
  have e5' : (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨5, by omega⟩, y), T5⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨6, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T6⟩ := by
    rw [e5, hT6, hT5i, write_cellsTape]
    rw [show (r₅ :: Q).tail = Q from rfl]
    rw [cellsTape_moveLeft]
  have hT6i : T6 i = cellsTape (r₃ :: r₂ :: r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₄ :: y :: Q) := by rw [hT6]; simp
  -- five retreats
  have e6 := shiftSeg5_step_left i T6 6 (by omega) (by omega) TapeSymbol.blank
  set T7 := Function.update T6 i
    (cellsTape (r₂ :: r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₃ :: r₄ :: y :: Q)) with hT7
  have e6' : (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨6, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T6⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨7, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T7⟩ := by
    rw [e6, hT7, hT6i, cellsTape_moveLeft]
  have hT7i : T7 i = cellsTape (r₂ :: r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₃ :: r₄ :: y :: Q) := by rw [hT7]; simp
  have e7 := shiftSeg5_step_left i T7 7 (by omega) (by omega) TapeSymbol.blank
  set T8 := Function.update T7 i
    (cellsTape (r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: y :: Q)) with hT8
  have e7' : (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨7, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T7⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨8, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T8⟩ := by
    rw [e7, hT8, hT7i, cellsTape_moveLeft]
  have hT8i : T8 i = cellsTape (r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: y :: Q) := by rw [hT8]; simp
  have e8 := shiftSeg5_step_left i T8 8 (by omega) (by omega) TapeSymbol.blank
  set T9 := Function.update T8 i
    (cellsTape (TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: y :: Q)) with hT9
  have e8' : (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨8, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T8⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨9, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T9⟩ := by
    rw [e8, hT9, hT8i, cellsTape_moveLeft]
  have hT9i : T9 i = cellsTape (TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: y :: Q) := by rw [hT9]; simp
  have e9 := shiftSeg5_step_left i T9 9 (by omega) (by omega) TapeSymbol.blank
  set T10 := Function.update T9 i
    (cellsTape (c :: L)
      (TapeSymbol.blank :: r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: y :: Q)) with hT10
  have e9' : (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨9, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T9⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨10, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T10⟩ := by
    rw [e9, hT10, hT9i, cellsTape_moveLeft]
  have hT10i : T10 i = cellsTape (c :: L)
      (TapeSymbol.blank :: r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: y :: Q) := by
    rw [hT10]; simp
  have e10 := shiftSeg5_step_home i T10 TapeSymbol.blank
  set T11 := Function.update T10 i
    (cellsTape L
      (c :: TapeSymbol.blank :: r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: y :: Q)) with hT11
  have e10' : (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨10, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T10⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T11⟩ := by
    rw [e10, hT11, hT10i, cellsTape_moveLeft]
  -- assemble
  have hflat : T11 = Function.update T i
      (cellsTape L (c :: TapeSymbol.blank :: r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ ::
        y :: Q)) := by
    rw [hT11, hT10, hT9, hT8, hT7, hT6, hT5, hT4, hT3, hT2, hT1]
    simp only [Function.update_idem]
  set M := shiftSeg5 i
  set c₀ : TypedConfiguration tapes (Fin 12 × TapeSymbol) :=
    ⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T⟩ with hc₀
  have p1 : (M.step^[1]) c₀ = ⟨(⟨1, by omega⟩, y), T1⟩ := by
    rw [Function.iterate_one, hc₀, e0']
  have p2 : (M.step^[2]) c₀ = ⟨(⟨2, by omega⟩, y), T2⟩ := by
    show (M.step^[1+1]) c₀ = _
    rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, p1, Function.iterate_one, e1']
  have p3 : (M.step^[3]) c₀ = ⟨(⟨3, by omega⟩, y), T3⟩ := by
    show (M.step^[1+2]) c₀ = _
    rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, p2, Function.iterate_one, e2']
  have p4 : (M.step^[4]) c₀ = ⟨(⟨4, by omega⟩, y), T4⟩ := by
    show (M.step^[1+3]) c₀ = _
    rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, p3, Function.iterate_one, e3']
  have p5 : (M.step^[5]) c₀ = ⟨(⟨5, by omega⟩, y), T5⟩ := by
    show (M.step^[1+4]) c₀ = _
    rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, p4, Function.iterate_one, e4']
  have p6 : (M.step^[6]) c₀ = ⟨(⟨6, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T6⟩ := by
    show (M.step^[1+5]) c₀ = _
    rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, p5, Function.iterate_one, e5']
  have p7 : (M.step^[7]) c₀ = ⟨(⟨7, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T7⟩ := by
    show (M.step^[1+6]) c₀ = _
    rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, p6, Function.iterate_one, e6']
  have p8 : (M.step^[8]) c₀ = ⟨(⟨8, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T8⟩ := by
    show (M.step^[1+7]) c₀ = _
    rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, p7, Function.iterate_one, e7']
  have p9 : (M.step^[9]) c₀ = ⟨(⟨9, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T9⟩ := by
    show (M.step^[1+8]) c₀ = _
    rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, p8, Function.iterate_one, e8']
  have p10 : (M.step^[10]) c₀ = ⟨(⟨10, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T10⟩ := by
    show (M.step^[1+9]) c₀ = _
    rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, p9, Function.iterate_one, e9']
  have p11 : (M.step^[11]) c₀ = ⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T11⟩ := by
    show (M.step^[1+10]) c₀ = _
    rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, p10, Function.iterate_one, e10']
  refine ⟨by rw [p11, hflat], ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  interval_cases j
  · simp [hc₀]
  · rw [p1]; simp
  · rw [p2]; simp
  · rw [p3]; simp
  · rw [p4]; simp
  · rw [p5]; simp
  · rw [p6]; simp
  · rw [p7]; simp
  · rw [p8]; simp
  · rw [p9]; simp
  · rw [p10]; simp


/-! ## The probe: normalising the right context

Walking five right and five back leaves the tape's *content* untouched but
forces at least five cells beyond the head to exist explicitly in the zipper —
materialised blanks become real.  This is what lets every shift cycle use the
explicit-cons form regardless of excursion history. -/

theorem allBlank_eq_replicate {G : List TapeSymbol} (hG : AllBlank G) :
    G = List.replicate G.length TapeSymbol.blank := by
  induction G with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c G' ih =>
      have hc : c = TapeSymbol.blank := hG c (by simp)
      have hG' : AllBlank G' := fun x hx => hG x (by simp [hx])
      rw [List.length_cons, List.replicate_succ, hc]
      exact congrArg _ (by conv_lhs => rw [ih hG'])

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
theorem moveDir_probe5 (c y : TapeSymbol) (L G : List TapeSymbol)
    (hG : AllBlank G) :
    ((moveDir HeadMove.left)^[5]) (((moveDir HeadMove.right)^[5])
        (cellsTape (c :: L) (y :: G))) =
      cellsTape (c :: L)
        (y :: List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ G.drop 5) := by
  rw [allBlank_eq_replicate hG]
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge G.length 5 with h5 | h5
  · interval_cases h : G.length <;>
      simp [List.replicate, cellsTape, moveDir, Tape.move,
        Function.iterate_succ_apply, Function.iterate_zero]
  · obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h5
    rw [hd]
    rw [show List.replicate (5 + d) TapeSymbol.blank =
      List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ List.replicate d TapeSymbol.blank
      from (List.replicate_add 5 d _).symm ▸ rfl]
    rw [show (List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++
        List.replicate d TapeSymbol.blank).drop 5 =
      List.replicate d TapeSymbol.blank by
        rw [List.drop_append_of_le_length (by simp)]
        simp]
    -- five explicit cells: round trip is the identity
    simp only [List.replicate, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
    simp [Function.iterate_succ_apply, cellsTape_moveRight,
      cellsTape_moveLeft, moveDir, Tape.move, cellsTape]


/-! ## The whole segment -/

theorem shiftSeg5_run (i : Fin tapes) :
    ∀ (ls : List TapeSymbol) (h : TapeSymbol) (B Q : List TapeSymbol)
      (T : Fin tapes → Tape),
      h ≠ TapeSymbol.blank → (∀ c ∈ ls, c ≠ TapeSymbol.blank) →
      T i = cellsTape (ls ++ TapeSymbol.blank :: B)
        (h :: List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ Q) →
      (((shiftSeg5 i).step^[11 * (ls.length + 1)])
          ⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T⟩ :
        TypedConfiguration tapes (Fin 12 × TapeSymbol)) =
        ⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank),
          Function.update T i
            (cellsTape B (TapeSymbol.blank ::
              List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ (ls.reverse ++ h :: Q)))⟩ ∧
      ∀ j, j < 11 * (ls.length + 1) →
        ((((shiftSeg5 i).step^[j])
            ⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T⟩ :
          TypedConfiguration tapes (Fin 12 × TapeSymbol))).state.1.val ≠ 11 := by
  intro ls
  induction ls with
  | nil =>
      intro h B Q T hh _ hTi
      have hshape : T i = cellsTape (TapeSymbol.blank :: B)
          (h :: TapeSymbol.blank :: TapeSymbol.blank :: TapeSymbol.blank ::
            TapeSymbol.blank :: TapeSymbol.blank :: Q) := by
        rw [hTi]; rfl
      obtain ⟨hrun, hfresh⟩ := shiftSeg5_cycle i T TapeSymbol.blank h
        TapeSymbol.blank TapeSymbol.blank TapeSymbol.blank TapeSymbol.blank
        TapeSymbol.blank B Q hh hshape
      constructor
      · rw [show 11 * (([] : List TapeSymbol).length + 1) = 11 by simp, hrun]
        rfl
      · intro j hj
        exact hfresh j (by simpa using hj)
  | cons l ls' ih =>
      intro h B Q T hh hls hTi
      have hl : l ≠ TapeSymbol.blank := hls l (by simp)
      have hls' : ∀ c ∈ ls', c ≠ TapeSymbol.blank :=
        fun c hc => hls c (by simp [hc])
      have hshape : T i = cellsTape (l :: (ls' ++ TapeSymbol.blank :: B))
          (h :: TapeSymbol.blank :: TapeSymbol.blank :: TapeSymbol.blank ::
            TapeSymbol.blank :: TapeSymbol.blank :: Q) := by
        rw [hTi]; rfl
      obtain ⟨hcyc, hcfresh⟩ := shiftSeg5_cycle i T l h
        TapeSymbol.blank TapeSymbol.blank TapeSymbol.blank TapeSymbol.blank
        TapeSymbol.blank (ls' ++ TapeSymbol.blank :: B) Q hh hshape
      set T' := Function.update T i
        (cellsTape (ls' ++ TapeSymbol.blank :: B)
          (l :: TapeSymbol.blank :: TapeSymbol.blank :: TapeSymbol.blank ::
            TapeSymbol.blank :: TapeSymbol.blank :: h :: Q)) with hT'
      have hT'i : T' i = cellsTape (ls' ++ TapeSymbol.blank :: B)
          (l :: List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ (h :: Q)) := by
        rw [hT']; simp
      obtain ⟨hrun', hfresh'⟩ := ih l B (h :: Q) T' hl hls' hT'i
      have hsplit : 11 * ((l :: ls').length + 1) =
          11 * (ls'.length + 1) + 11 := by simp [List.length_cons]; ring
      constructor
      · rw [hsplit, Function.iterate_add_apply, hcyc, hrun', hT']
        simp only [Function.update_idem]
        rw [show ls'.reverse ++ l :: (h :: Q) =
          (l :: ls').reverse ++ h :: Q by simp]
      · intro j hj
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j 11 with hj11 | hj11
        · exact hcfresh j hj11
        · obtain ⟨j', rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hj11
          rw [Nat.add_comm, Function.iterate_add_apply, hcyc]
          exact hfresh' j' (by rw [hsplit] at hj; omega)

/-- **The segment shifter, as a subroutine.**  `ls` is the segment's cells
left of the head cell `h`, nearest first; everything moves five right, the
head retreats to the boundary blank. -/
theorem shiftSeg5_spec (i : Fin tapes) (ls : List TapeSymbol)
    (h : TapeSymbol) (B Q : List TapeSymbol) (T : Fin tapes → Tape)
    (hh : h ≠ TapeSymbol.blank) (hls : ∀ c ∈ ls, c ≠ TapeSymbol.blank)
    (hTi : T i = cellsTape (ls ++ TapeSymbol.blank :: B)
      (h :: List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ Q)) :
    HaltsExactly (shiftSeg5 i) ((shiftSeg5 i).startCfg T)
      (11 * (ls.length + 1) + 1) false ∧
    (((shiftSeg5 i).step^[11 * (ls.length + 1) + 1])
        ((shiftSeg5 i).startCfg T)).tape =
      Function.update T i
        (cellsTape B (TapeSymbol.blank ::
          List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ (ls.reverse ++ h :: Q))) := by
  obtain ⟨hrun, hfresh⟩ := shiftSeg5_run i ls h B Q T hh hls hTi
  have hstart : (shiftSeg5 i).startCfg T =
      (⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T⟩ :
        TypedConfiguration tapes (Fin 12 × TapeSymbol)) := rfl
  set Tf := Function.update T i
    (cellsTape B (TapeSymbol.blank ::
      List.replicate 5 TapeSymbol.blank ++ (ls.reverse ++ h :: Q))) with hTf
  have hTfi : (Tf i).head = TapeSymbol.blank := by
    rw [hTf]; simp; rfl
  have hlast : (((shiftSeg5 i).step^[11 * (ls.length + 1) + 1])
      ((shiftSeg5 i).startCfg T) :
      TypedConfiguration tapes (Fin 12 × TapeSymbol)) =
      ⟨(⟨11, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), Tf⟩ := by
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', hstart, hrun, shiftSeg5_step_halt i Tf hTfi]
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [hlast]
    rfl
  · intro j hj
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j (11 * (ls.length + 1)) with hlt | hge
    · have hne := hfresh j hlt
      rw [hstart]
      exact if_neg hne
    · have hj' : j = 11 * (ls.length + 1) := by omega
      subst hj'
      rw [hstart, hrun]
      rfl
  · rw [hlast]

end SipserGacsLautemann

theorems.natural_language_statement:
The segment shifter: the primitive for in-place input dilation under a three-symbol alphabet.

`shiftSeg5 i` expects the head on the rightmost cell of a non-blank segment. Each eleven-step cycle picks the cell up (erasing it), carries it five cells right, drops it, and retreats to the cell left of the vacated one; a pickup that reads blank halts the machine. Right-to-left order is what makes the target always blank — cells to the right have already moved. `shiftSeg5_spec` runs it over a whole segment: cost $11(|{\rm seg}|)+1$, every cell translated five right, head parked on the boundary blank, with the vacated cells left explicitly blank.

**The probe.** The zipper representation records only cells actually visited, so a segment's right context may be a *materialised-blank history* of any length — the visited-blank problem, again. `moveDir_probe5` resolves it without touching the shift machine: walking five right and five back changes no content but forces at least five cells beyond the head to exist explicitly, after which every cycle can use the explicit six-cell window form. One lemma, pure tape algebra, no machine case analysis.

**A design simplification found while building this.** The dilation needs no separate shift-by-one pre-pass: running this same shifter once over the whole input creates a *five*-blank separator region, and the block-writing loop maintains five-blank separators invariantly — each iteration's six-cell block overwrites the five separators plus the harvested cell, and the shift vacates the next five. One primitive machine serves the entire dilation.
theorems.definition:
import Definitions.Def_sgl_merge_solution

/-!
# Shifting a segment right by five

Module G1 of DESIGN_finish_mission: the primitive for in-place input dilation.

`shiftSeg5 i` expects the head on the rightmost cell of a non-blank segment
whose right context is blank far enough out.  Each eleven-step cycle picks the
cell up (erasing it), carries it five cells right, drops it, and returns to
the cell to the left of the vacated one; when the pickup reads blank the
machine halts.  Right-to-left order is what makes the target cell always
blank: cells to the right have already moved.
-/

namespace SipserGacsLautemann

variable {tapes : Nat}

/-- Carry one cell five to the right, repeatedly, right to left. -/
def shiftSeg5 (i : Fin tapes) : TypedMachine tapes (Fin 12 × TapeSymbol) where
  start := (⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank)
  transition := fun s symbols =>
    if _h0 : s.1.val = 0 then
      if symbols i = TapeSymbol.blank then
        ((⟨11, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank),
          fun j => (symbols j, HeadMove.stay))
      else
        ((⟨1, by omega⟩, symbols i),
          fun j =>
            (if j = i then TapeSymbol.blank else symbols j,
              if j = i then HeadMove.right else HeadMove.stay))
    else if _h4 : s.1.val ≤ 4 then
      ((⟨s.1.val + 1, by omega⟩, s.2),
        fun j => (symbols j, if j = i then HeadMove.right else HeadMove.stay))
    else if _h5 : s.1.val = 5 then
      ((⟨6, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank),
        fun j =>
          (if j = i then s.2 else symbols j,
            if j = i then HeadMove.left else HeadMove.stay))
    else if _h9 : s.1.val ≤ 9 then
      ((⟨s.1.val + 1, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank),
        fun j => (symbols j, if j = i then HeadMove.left else HeadMove.stay))
    else if _h10 : s.1.val = 10 then
      ((⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank),
        fun j => (symbols j, if j = i then HeadMove.left else HeadMove.stay))
    else (s, fun j => (symbols j, HeadMove.stay))
  result := fun s => if s.1.val = 11 then some false else none

/-! ## Step equations -/

theorem shiftSeg5_step_halt (i : Fin tapes) (t : Fin tapes → Tape)
    (hb : (t i).head = TapeSymbol.blank) :
    (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), t⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨11, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), t⟩ := by
  have hres : (shiftSeg5 i).result (⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank) = none := by
    simp [shiftSeg5]
  simp only [TypedMachine.step, hres]
  simp only [shiftSeg5, hb]
  norm_num
  funext j
  simp [Tape.write_head_self, Tape.move]

theorem shiftSeg5_step_pick (i : Fin tapes) (t : Fin tapes → Tape)
    (hb : (t i).head ≠ TapeSymbol.blank) :
    (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), t⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨1, by omega⟩, (t i).head),
        Function.update t i
          (moveDir HeadMove.right (Tape.write (t i) TapeSymbol.blank))⟩ := by
  have hres : (shiftSeg5 i).result (⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank) = none := by
    simp [shiftSeg5]
  simp only [TypedMachine.step, hres]
  simp only [shiftSeg5]
  norm_num [hb]
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst hj
    simp [moveDir]
  · simp [hj, Function.update_of_ne hj, Tape.write_head_self, Tape.move]

theorem shiftSeg5_step_right (i : Fin tapes) (t : Fin tapes → Tape)
    (k : Nat) (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk4 : k ≤ 4) (x : TapeSymbol) :
    (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨k, by omega⟩, x), t⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨k + 1, by omega⟩, x),
        Function.update t i (moveDir HeadMove.right (t i))⟩ := by
  have hres : (shiftSeg5 i).result (⟨k, by omega⟩, x) = none := by
    simp only [shiftSeg5]
    exact if_neg (by omega)
  simp only [TypedMachine.step, hres]
  simp only [shiftSeg5]
  rw [dif_neg (show ¬ (k = 0) by omega)]
  rw [dif_pos (show k ≤ 4 from hk4)]
  congr 1
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst hj
    simp [moveDir, Tape.write_head_self]
  · simp [hj, Function.update_of_ne hj, Tape.write_head_self, Tape.move]

theorem shiftSeg5_step_drop (i : Fin tapes) (t : Fin tapes → Tape)
    (x : TapeSymbol) :
    (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨5, by omega⟩, x), t⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨6, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank),
        Function.update t i (moveDir HeadMove.left (Tape.write (t i) x))⟩ := by
  have hres : (shiftSeg5 i).result (⟨5, by omega⟩, x) = none := by
    simp [shiftSeg5]
  simp only [TypedMachine.step, hres]
  simp only [shiftSeg5]
  norm_num
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst hj
    simp [moveDir]
  · simp [hj, Function.update_of_ne hj, Tape.write_head_self, Tape.move]

theorem shiftSeg5_step_left (i : Fin tapes) (t : Fin tapes → Tape)
    (k : Nat) (hk6 : 6 ≤ k) (hk9 : k ≤ 9) (x : TapeSymbol) :
    (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨k, by omega⟩, x), t⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨k + 1, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank),
        Function.update t i (moveDir HeadMove.left (t i))⟩ := by
  have hres : (shiftSeg5 i).result (⟨k, by omega⟩, x) = none := by
    simp only [shiftSeg5]
    exact if_neg (by omega)
  simp only [TypedMachine.step, hres]
  simp only [shiftSeg5]
  rw [dif_neg (show ¬ (k = 0) by omega), dif_neg (show ¬ (k ≤ 4) by omega),
    dif_neg (show ¬ (k = 5) by omega), dif_pos (show k ≤ 9 from hk9)]
  congr 1
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst hj
    simp [moveDir, Tape.write_head_self]
  · simp [hj, Function.update_of_ne hj, Tape.write_head_self, Tape.move]

theorem shiftSeg5_step_home (i : Fin tapes) (t : Fin tapes → Tape)
    (x : TapeSymbol) :
    (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨10, by omega⟩, x), t⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank),
        Function.update t i (moveDir HeadMove.left (t i))⟩ := by
  have hres : (shiftSeg5 i).result (⟨10, by omega⟩, x) = none := by
    simp [shiftSeg5]
  simp only [TypedMachine.step, hres]
  simp only [shiftSeg5]
  norm_num
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst hj
    simp [moveDir, Tape.write_head_self]
  · simp [hj, Function.update_of_ne hj, Tape.write_head_self, Tape.move]


/-! ## Blank-context move helpers -/

theorem moveDir_right_blank (L R : List TapeSymbol) (hR : AllBlank R) :
    moveDir HeadMove.right (cellsTape L R) =
      cellsTape (TapeSymbol.blank :: L) R.tail := by
  cases R with
  | nil => exact cellsTape_moveRight_nil L
  | cons r R' =>
      have hr : r = TapeSymbol.blank := hR r (by simp)
      rw [show cellsTape L (r :: R') = cellsTape L (TapeSymbol.blank :: R') by
        rw [hr]]
      exact cellsTape_moveRight L TapeSymbol.blank R'

theorem write_cellsTape (L R : List TapeSymbol) (y : TapeSymbol) :
    Tape.write (cellsTape L R) y = cellsTape L (y :: R.tail) := by
  cases R <;> rfl

/-! ## One eleven-step cycle, explicit-cons right context -/

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
/-- One cycle over a six-cell window: the head cell moves five right, the
window's other five cells are preserved, the head retreats one left of the
vacated cell. -/
theorem shiftSeg5_cycle (i : Fin tapes) (T : Fin tapes → Tape)
    (c y r₁ r₂ r₃ r₄ r₅ : TapeSymbol) (L Q : List TapeSymbol)
    (hy : y ≠ TapeSymbol.blank)
    (hTi : T i = cellsTape (c :: L) (y :: r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: r₅ :: Q)) :
    (((shiftSeg5 i).step^[11]) ⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T⟩ :
        TypedConfiguration tapes (Fin 12 × TapeSymbol)) =
      ⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank),
        Function.update T i
          (cellsTape L (c :: TapeSymbol.blank :: r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ ::
            y :: Q))⟩ ∧
    ∀ j, j < 11 →
      ((((shiftSeg5 i).step^[j]) ⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T⟩ :
        TypedConfiguration tapes (Fin 12 × TapeSymbol))).state.1.val ≠ 11 := by
  have hy' : (T i).head = y := by rw [hTi]; rfl
  have e0 := shiftSeg5_step_pick i T (by rw [hy']; exact hy)
  rw [hy'] at e0
  set T1 := Function.update T i
    (cellsTape (TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: r₅ :: Q)) with hT1
  have e0' : (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨1, by omega⟩, y), T1⟩ := by
    rw [e0, hT1, hTi, write_cellsTape]
    rw [show (y :: r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: r₅ :: Q).tail =
      r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: r₅ :: Q from rfl]
    rw [cellsTape_moveRight]
  have hT1i : T1 i = cellsTape (TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: r₅ :: Q) := by rw [hT1]; simp
  -- four carries right
  have e1 := shiftSeg5_step_right i T1 1 (by omega) (by omega) y
  set T2 := Function.update T1 i
    (cellsTape (r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L) (r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: r₅ :: Q))
    with hT2
  have e1' : (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨1, by omega⟩, y), T1⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨2, by omega⟩, y), T2⟩ := by
    rw [e1, hT2, hT1i, cellsTape_moveRight]
  have hT2i : T2 i = cellsTape (r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: r₅ :: Q) := by rw [hT2]; simp
  have e2 := shiftSeg5_step_right i T2 2 (by omega) (by omega) y
  set T3 := Function.update T2 i
    (cellsTape (r₂ :: r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L) (r₃ :: r₄ :: r₅ :: Q))
    with hT3
  have e2' : (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨2, by omega⟩, y), T2⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨3, by omega⟩, y), T3⟩ := by
    rw [e2, hT3, hT2i, cellsTape_moveRight]
  have hT3i : T3 i = cellsTape (r₂ :: r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₃ :: r₄ :: r₅ :: Q) := by rw [hT3]; simp
  have e3 := shiftSeg5_step_right i T3 3 (by omega) (by omega) y
  set T4 := Function.update T3 i
    (cellsTape (r₃ :: r₂ :: r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₄ :: r₅ :: Q)) with hT4
  have e3' : (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨3, by omega⟩, y), T3⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨4, by omega⟩, y), T4⟩ := by
    rw [e3, hT4, hT3i, cellsTape_moveRight]
  have hT4i : T4 i = cellsTape (r₃ :: r₂ :: r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₄ :: r₅ :: Q) := by rw [hT4]; simp
  have e4 := shiftSeg5_step_right i T4 4 (by omega) (by omega) y
  set T5 := Function.update T4 i
    (cellsTape (r₄ :: r₃ :: r₂ :: r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₅ :: Q)) with hT5
  have e4' : (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨4, by omega⟩, y), T4⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨5, by omega⟩, y), T5⟩ := by
    rw [e4, hT5, hT4i, cellsTape_moveRight]
  have hT5i : T5 i = cellsTape
      (r₄ :: r₃ :: r₂ :: r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L) (r₅ :: Q) := by
    rw [hT5]; simp
  -- drop
  have e5 := shiftSeg5_step_drop i T5 y
  set T6 := Function.update T5 i
    (cellsTape (r₃ :: r₂ :: r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₄ :: y :: Q)) with hT6
  have e5' : (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨5, by omega⟩, y), T5⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨6, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T6⟩ := by
    rw [e5, hT6, hT5i, write_cellsTape]
    rw [show (r₅ :: Q).tail = Q from rfl]
    rw [cellsTape_moveLeft]
  have hT6i : T6 i = cellsTape (r₃ :: r₂ :: r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₄ :: y :: Q) := by rw [hT6]; simp
  -- five retreats
  have e6 := shiftSeg5_step_left i T6 6 (by omega) (by omega) TapeSymbol.blank
  set T7 := Function.update T6 i
    (cellsTape (r₂ :: r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₃ :: r₄ :: y :: Q)) with hT7
  have e6' : (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨6, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T6⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨7, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T7⟩ := by
    rw [e6, hT7, hT6i, cellsTape_moveLeft]
  have hT7i : T7 i = cellsTape (r₂ :: r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₃ :: r₄ :: y :: Q) := by rw [hT7]; simp
  have e7 := shiftSeg5_step_left i T7 7 (by omega) (by omega) TapeSymbol.blank
  set T8 := Function.update T7 i
    (cellsTape (r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: y :: Q)) with hT8
  have e7' : (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨7, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T7⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨8, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T8⟩ := by
    rw [e7, hT8, hT7i, cellsTape_moveLeft]
  have hT8i : T8 i = cellsTape (r₁ :: TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: y :: Q) := by rw [hT8]; simp
  have e8 := shiftSeg5_step_left i T8 8 (by omega) (by omega) TapeSymbol.blank
  set T9 := Function.update T8 i
    (cellsTape (TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: y :: Q)) with hT9
  have e8' : (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨8, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T8⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨9, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T9⟩ := by
    rw [e8, hT9, hT8i, cellsTape_moveLeft]
  have hT9i : T9 i = cellsTape (TapeSymbol.blank :: c :: L)
      (r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: y :: Q) := by rw [hT9]; simp
  have e9 := shiftSeg5_step_left i T9 9 (by omega) (by omega) TapeSymbol.blank
  set T10 := Function.update T9 i
    (cellsTape (c :: L)
      (TapeSymbol.blank :: r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: y :: Q)) with hT10
  have e9' : (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨9, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T9⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨10, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T10⟩ := by
    rw [e9, hT10, hT9i, cellsTape_moveLeft]
  have hT10i : T10 i = cellsTape (c :: L)
      (TapeSymbol.blank :: r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: y :: Q) := by
    rw [hT10]; simp
  have e10 := shiftSeg5_step_home i T10 TapeSymbol.blank
  set T11 := Function.update T10 i
    (cellsTape L
      (c :: TapeSymbol.blank :: r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ :: y :: Q)) with hT11
  have e10' : (shiftSeg5 i).step ⟨(⟨10, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T10⟩ =
      ⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T11⟩ := by
    rw [e10, hT11, hT10i, cellsTape_moveLeft]
  -- assemble
  have hflat : T11 = Function.update T i
      (cellsTape L (c :: TapeSymbol.blank :: r₁ :: r₂ :: r₃ :: r₄ ::
        y :: Q)) := by
    rw [hT11, hT10, hT9, hT8, hT7, hT6, hT5, hT4, hT3, hT2, hT1]
    simp only [Function.update_idem]
  set M := shiftSeg5 i
  set c₀ : TypedConfiguration tapes (Fin 12 × TapeSymbol) :=
    ⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩, TapeSymbol.blank), T⟩ with hc₀
  have p1 : (M.step^[1]) c₀ = ⟨(⟨1, by omega⟩, y), T1⟩ := by
    rw [Function.iterate_one, hc₀, e0']
  have p2 : (M.step^[2]) c₀ = ⟨(⟨2, by omega⟩, y), T2⟩ := by
    show (M.step^[1+1]) c₀ = _
    rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, p1, Function.iterate_one, e1']
  have p3 : (M.step^[3]) c₀ = ⟨(⟨3, by omega⟩, y), T3⟩ := by
    show (M.step^[1+2]) c₀ = _
    rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, p2, Function.iterate_one, e2']
  have p4 : (M.step^[4]) c₀ = ⟨(⟨4, by omega⟩, y), T4⟩ := by
    show (M.step^[1+3]) c₀ = _
    rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, p3, Function.iterate_one, e3']
